title: Tangled Pearl
author: Ren Huanyou
synopsis:
[An emotionally detached woman hidden under a delicate facade vs. A gloomy, love-starved, humble, and clingy man]
Shen Yuanzhu, a woman who valued money above all else, gave what little sincerity she possessed to Xie Xuchuan, only for him to turn around and have a child with someone else.

He said, “Yuanzhu, you raise the child. The inheritance will go to him, and I will give you other forms of compensation.”

Shen Yuanzhu thought he had lost his mind.

Since the engagement was bound by mutual interests and could not be dissolved, she chose to simply swap the man. After all, Xie Xuchuan wasn’t the only choice in the Xie family!

Just as she locked onto her target, she was snatched into a wolf’s den by a “wicked wolf” lurking in the shadows.

Both belonged to the Xie family’s primary branch, but while Xie Xuchuan was the family’s pride and joy, Xie Qi was treated like weeds by the roadside and soot on a pot.

Xie Qi refused to accept this, so he fought and he snatched.

During the day, while Xie Xuchuan and Shen Yuanzhu passed each other by, at night, Xie Qi would lie on the ground at death’s door: “Yuanzhu, have some pity on me…”

Whenever Xie Xuchuan and Shen Yuanzhu’s eyes met, Xie Qi would say: “Yuanzhu, give me a hug…”

Shen Yuanzhu was driven to distraction by Xie Qi, that two-faced demon.

Holding Shen Yuanzhu, Xie Qi said, “A stolen wife is truly the sweetest.”

chapters.title: Pregnant
chapters.content:
"Yuanzhu, I want to bring our wedding date forward."

"Forward?"

Shen Yuanzhu was puzzled: "Wasn't our wedding date set for August? It's already mid-April now, why the sudden rush?"

Shen Yuanzhu had just reached capping age, her rounded cheeks still tinged with a hint of childish innocence.

Today, she wore a peach-red jacket embroidered with gold, setting off her chubby little face to look like she was carved from pink jade and polished with pearls.

Hearing this, she only offered a slightly shy smile.

The Xie and Shen families had been betrothed for a long time; she and Xie Xuchuan had eaten from the same bowl at age three and gone out together at age five. Their bond could not have been deeper.

Moreover, having not seen each other for a long time, she missed him dearly.

Yet before her smile had even faded, she caught a flash of embarrassment cross Xie Xuchuan's face.

"Yuanzhu, Huansu is already two months pregnant, and in a few months her belly will begin to show. I want to take the child in her womb and place them under our names, as the legitimate heir.

"If the wedding is in August, her condition will inevitably show. Huansu is still unwed in her boudoir; if people were to find out she conceived before marriage, it would truly be detrimental to her reputation."

A lump of coarse hemp seemed stuck in Xie Xuchuan's throat, choking him so he could neither swallow it nor spit it out.

Upon learning the news of Jiang Huansu's pregnancy, he had hurried back from Huizhou, drafting countless mental speeches along the way. Yet now, standing before Yuanzhu, he could finally only utter this most difficult sentence.

"Miss Jiang being pregnant, what does that have to do with my young lady's wedding..."

Before Ling'er could finish her words, she was pulled away by the wet nurse, Mother Luo.

Beneath the eaves of the Shen family corridor, only the two of them remained.

After a long silence, Shen Yuanzhu finally spoke in a low voice: "The child in her womb, is it yours?"

Xie Xuchuan clenched his jaw, staying silent for a long time.

He neither admitted it nor denied it.

With a breath trapped in her chest, Shen Yuanzhu turned her head away so she wouldn't have to look at him.

She refused to look at the fiancé she had been betrothed to for over a decade, the one who had carried her on his back since childhood.

After a long while, she pinched the pearl tassels on her white jade dress-pendant, her voice trembling slightly: "You're afraid Jiang Huansu will lose her reputation for premarital pregnancy, but aren't you afraid that if I marry into the Xie family and a child pops up in less than eight months, my reputation will be ruined?

"And you're asking me to adopt this child as my own, what about Jiang Huansu then? How do you plan to settle Jiang Huansu? Do you intend to take her as a concubine?"

Xie Xuchuan raised his head, his eyes bloodshot: "Once the child is born, we will just say you experienced fetal agitation and gave birth prematurely. Rest assured, I won't let anyone blemish your purity.

"Nor will I take Huansu as a concubine. For three generations, the Xie family has had no precedent of taking concubines; Grandmother wouldn't allow it either..."

Xie Xuchuan's voice dropped a little: "It's just that I want Huansu to stay in the Xie family during her confinement so she can bring the child safely into the world.

"Just one year... Yuanzhu, just one year, and she will leave once her health is restored.

"After a year, you and I... will be just as we were before."

Afraid that Shen Yuanzhu would refuse, Xie Xuchuan's voice softened, carrying a hint of pleading: "Yuanzhu, the two of you are somewhat acquainted, you know Huansu is different from you. She is gentle by nature and uncontentious. Not only is she disliked by her father, but she doesn't catch the eye of Madam Jiang or her legitimate elder sister.

"It's not easy for her to survive in the Jiang family. If Old Master Jiang finds out she's pregnant out of wedlock, she will undoubtedly meet the fate of dying with her child."

Xie Xuchuan spoke so lightly, yet every word sent a dull ache through Shen Yuanzhu's chest.

"It's not easy for her to survive in the Jiang family, so she gives birth to a child to be the Xie family's legitimate heir, and then she goes back to the Jiang family to live easily?"

Hearing this, Xie Xuchuan stammered: "The child will be registered under your and my names, and Huansu... I will buy an estate outside to let her recuperate her health. Since the Jiang family doesn't value her anyway, we'll just find an excuse then, saying she's going out to convalesce. The Jiang family will agree."

Xie Xuchuan's voice grew lower and lower. Shen Yuanzhu watched his lips move, but the scene before her eyes gradually blurred.

A distant, lingering chant echoed in her ears, and the tip of her nose seemed to catch the scent of yellow paper burning into ash.

Ah yes, that was the time when her parents passed away one after another, and she fell gravely ill from excessive grief.

During her mother's funeral, her elder brother and sister-in-law refused to let her attend. It was a young Xie Xuchuan who climbed through the window to find her on the verge of death, carried her out the door on his back, and brought her to her mother's mourning hall so she could see her mother for the last time.

It was also Xie Xuchuan who carried her on his back as she offered incense and bowed to her mother.

And it was Xie Xuchuan who shielded her firmly on his back, telling her word for word: "It doesn't matter even if Yuanzhu has no father or mother left. From now on, you have me. As long as I live for a day, that day will be Yuanzhu's backing."

It was true they had been betrothed since childhood, but weren't Xie Xuchuan and Jiang Huansu also childhood sweethearts who had grown up sharing the same affections?

Looking at the handsome youth before her, whose eyes and brows were filled with a familiar tenderness, and whose every move she knew so well, Shen Yuanzhu finally closed her eyes slowly.

Affections of youth faded away overnight.

Shen Yuanzhu said: "If you insist on acknowledging this child, you may bring Jiang Huansu back to the Xie family or keep her housed outside the estate. Whatever status you wish to give her, I do not care. But the matter of making the child the legitimate heir is pure delusion."

"Yuanzhu, I have no intention whatsoever of taking a concubine or keeping a mistress outside."

A trace of pain flashed in Xie Xuchuan's eyes: "I know I have failed you, but my heart has never wavered from you. It is I who have wronged you in this matter, and I will surely compensate you and the Shen family in the future.

"Yuanzhu, adopting this child as our legitimate son is something I promised Huansu; I cannot break my word."

"You promised?"

For some reason, Shen Yuanzhu let out a cold, mocking laugh: "Xie Xuchuan, have you forgotten how the betrothal between the Xie and Shen families came to be?"

***

chapters.title: Fading Affection
chapters.content:
Ten years ago, the Xie and Shen families were merely making their names in Suzhou Prefecture. Although the Xie weaving workshop and the Shen dyeing workshop each possessed secret techniques, breakthroughs were difficult to come by.

It was Xie Xuchuan's grandmother, Madam Xie San, who sought out her father and proposed a betrothal between the two families.

The Xie family offered the first half of the "Xie Family Tilling and Weaving Atlas" as a betrothal gift, while the Shen family exchanged the second half of the "Shen Family Dyeing Manual" as part of their dowry.

Armed with the Shen family's dyeing manual, the Xie family wove the purple cloud brocade that shocked the world.

Meanwhile, with the Xie family's tilling and weaving atlas, the Shen family created new looms and patterns.

It was only through this that the two families rapidly rose over the decade, becoming unshakable major clans throughout Suzhou Prefecture.

Over the years, the weaving and dyeing businesses of the Xie and Shen families had long become intertwined and inseparable. Therefore, no matter what, the betrothal between the Xie and Shen families could never be broken.

And the legitimate son born to her and Xie Xuchuan meant that he would eventually inherit the complete "Xie Family Tilling and Weaving Atlas" and "Shen Family Dyeing Manual," as well as the entire Xie family estate and a portion of the Shen family business.

What he and Jiang Huansu wanted was far more than just the title of a legitimate son.

What they wanted was the entirety of both the Xie and Shen family industries.

Shen Yuanzhu gripped her skirt tightly, barely concealing the anger in her tone: "The Xie family motto states: 'United, the clan flourishes; divided, the clan declines. Any descendant who divides the family without cause shall have their name struck and their branch expelled.' If this child occupies the position of the eldest legitimate son, my own child will never have a day to get ahead.

"Not to mention that I would never agree, and the Shen family would never agree, even the Xie family itself would never acknowledge an unknown child of murky origins as their eldest legitimate son."

Xie Xuchuan's voice trembled: "I will beg Grandmother to agree, Yuanzhu. I know I have wronged you in this, but trust me, I will surely compensate you and our child in the future.

"Right now, I only beg of you, beg you to help me.

"Everyone in the weaving and dyeing chamber of commerce knows that your Shen elder brother swore before your mother's mourning hall to treat you kindly, and promised that upon your marriage, you could take any single item from the Shen family as your dowry. If you just open your mouth to plead, your Shen elder brother will surely agree.

"As long as the Shen family consents, Grandmother, for the sake of your elder brother, will eventually agree."

"Yuanzhu, I beg you, please help me this once..."

Shen Yuanzhu looked at the person before her, feeling only that Xie Xuchuan had become so unfamiliar it chilled her heart.

Her elder brother and sister-in-law appeared magnanimous on the surface, but in reality, they were constantly on guard against her and made things difficult for her behind the scenes.

That sister-in-law of hers, in particular, used every underhanded trick imaginable, both openly and covertly.

If she hadn't deliberately played the fool and acted obedient all these years, the meager property left by her mother would have been completely devoured long ago.

Xie Xuchuan was not entirely unaware of these things; it was simply that in his heart, any grievance she suffered could not compare to the importance of the child in Jiang Huansu's womb.

Shen Yuanzhu pressed her lips together, her still-youthful face showing a sense of resolve: "With what do you plan to compensate me and the Shen family?"

Xie Xuchuan said: "Although the betrothal between the Xie and Shen families was driven by interests, you and I were childhood sweethearts after all, with genuine affection as our foundation. Moreover, I know you are marrying me to be my wife, not for the Xie family's estate."

Hearing this, Shen Yuanzhu couldn't help but knit her brows.

Seeing her displeasure, Xie Xuchuan carefully considered his words and added: "We grew up together; you know my character. I am never someone who makes empty oaths with hollow words."

"I swear that in the future, I will never mistreat our own child for the sake of this other child.

"Besides, Huansu has been pregnant for a little over two months, and it is still unknown whether it's a boy or a girl. If it's a girl, everything you worry about ceases to exist."

Shen Yuanzhu remained silent, yet Xie Xuchuan didn't dare stop speaking.

He was afraid that once he stopped, he would lose the courage to speak ever again.

"Even if this child is a boy, rest assured, I will not let him take advantage of the Shen family in the slightest. The dowry left to you by your mother, as well as the 'Shen Family Dyeing Manual,' will never be handed over to him.

"In addition, I will carve out other industries for our own child."

"What industries?"

Shen Yuanzhu asked: "Aside from a daughter's dowry, no descendants of the Xie family hold private property.

"Xie sons, even if they earn a single copper coin outside, must turn it over to the family public fund. As the eldest grandson of the direct lineage, where would you get other industries from?"

Perhaps it was because she had been so compliant and obedient all these years that Xie Xuchuan had forgotten how her mother had taught her the skills of commerce and calculation step-by-step when she was still learning to babble.

"I..."

Xie Xuchuan didn't understand why today's Yuanzhu was so different from usual.

He had never seen Shen Yuanzhu look so sharp and aggressive.

In his memory, his Yuanzhu had always been gentle and warm, greeting him with a sweet smile. Because of her tender age, her face often carried a young girl's shyness and budding affections.

Thinking of this, Xie Xuchuan's eyes turned red: "Yuanzhu, trust me. You know I have the ability to provide you and our children with a life of wealth, security, and honor."

The Xie family members were all blessed with good looks, and Xie Xuchuan was no exception.

His bright eyes and ink-painted brows radiated the vibrant spirit and soaring ambition of a youthful man in every smile and gaze.

She had seen Xie Xuchuan in many states, but she had never seen him looking so humble, pitifully begging others in such a wretched plight.

Shen Yuanzhu turned her gaze away, her eyes sweeping over the rosewood chest placed in the long pavilion, a sharp pang tearing through her heart.

That was the clothing and embroidered handkerchiefs she had sewn for him while he was away in Huizhou. Looking at them now, they inexplicably felt somewhat cloying.

For the first time, Shen Yuanzhu lost her patience to converse with him.

"Does Madam Xie know about Jiang Huansu's pregnancy?"

Xie Xuchuan stammered: "I came straight to the Shen family upon entering the city; I haven't told Mother yet."

"Madam Xie doesn't know..."

A wave of disappointment welled up in her heart.

No one in the Xie family knew about Jiang Huansu's pregnancy, nor would they agree to this hare-brained idea of his.

So when Xie Xuchuan came to find her and talked about compensation, he was merely trying to coax her into taking the lead.

He wanted her to persuade the Shen family to stand up for the illegitimate child in Jiang Huansu's womb and force the Xie family to compromise.

Such scheming, it was hard to tell whether it was utterly foolish or excessively calculating.

Suppressing the sourness in her eyes, Shen Yuanzhu said: "If I firmly refuse to adopt this child as the legitimate heir, to what lengths will you go for Jiang Huansu?"

***

chapters.title: Settling In
chapters.content:
"Yuanzhu."

The corners of Xie Xuchuan's eyes turned red, and he choked back his words for a long time without speaking.

Though he didn't utter a word, his brows and eyes were filled with the sorrow and grievance of one being forced against his will.

The glaring "don't make things difficult for me" in his eyes made Shen Yuanzhu fully aware of his stance.

With a light sigh, Shen Yuanzhu pointed to the stone table inside the pavilion and said: "You've traveled far, eat something first."

Xie Xuchuan hadn't expected her to react this way, and his heart grew even more anxious.

Yet he knew Yuanzhu was soft-hearted and their bond ran deep; over the years, Shen Yuanzhu had never refused any of his requests. Hesitating for a moment, he nodded with reddened eyes.

Looking at the still-warm food box, a bitter ache rose to the tip of his tongue.

Things had happened too suddenly, and he had been in a daze for the past few days. Now, seeing Yuanzhu, that fierce and oppressive aura within him seemed to be smoothed away, growing much more tranquil.

Xie Xuchuan picked up a piece of tea pastry and popped it into his mouth.

As his gaze swept over the rosewood chest placed on the ground, his fingertips trembled: "Yuanzhu, that chest..."

Every time he went out to collect materials, Yuanzhu would embroider some small items for him. Though unstated, Xie Xuchuan knew it was a longing hidden beneath shyness, a young girl's unspoken affection.

Shen Yuanzhu followed his gaze: "Just some unimportant things. I'll have Ling'er deal with them later."

A sharp pain pierced Xie Xuchuan's chest, and just as he was about to say something more, he heard Shen Yuanzhu speak again: "What is the price of madder grass in Huizhou this year?"

Though he had wanted to continue discussing Jiang Huansu, seeing Shen Yuanzhu ask this, Xie Xuchuan knew she had no desire to listen further, forcing him to suppress the anxiety in his heart.

"Much the same as last year."

Madder grass had the property of cooling the blood and removing stasis, showing miraculous efficacy for bruises, trauma, and abnormal uterine bleeding. For their weaving and dyeing businesses, madder grass was equally an essential dye; bright red, lotus red, silver red, and light pink all proved inseparable from it.

Moreover, true colors required nine dippings and nine dryings, consuming a considerable amount of madder grass each year.

With prices remaining unchanged this year, the fabric prices in her shop could be set comparably to last year.

Shen Yuanzhu forced herself to think only of business matters, entirely unaware that Xie Xuchuan's thoughts were already spinning through a hundred turns.

"The road from Huizhou is long. Eat your fill and then head back."

"Yuanzhu."

This was the first time Shen Yuanzhu had ever issued a dismissal to him, inexplicably causing Xie Xuchuan a surge of panic.

Yet the words lingered repeatedly on the tip of his tongue, ultimately falling into a single sentence: "About Huansu's matter..."

Shen Yuanzhu glanced at him: "On this trip to Huizhou, did you travel alongside Jiang Huansu?"

Xie Xuchuan hesitated for a fraction of a moment: "It wasn't just the two of us; it was the Jiang family..."

"I understand. You should head back."

Jiang Huansu's father was the direct nephew of the eunuch imperial textile commissioner Jiang You. Although he held no proper official title, his authority was not insignificant; even the Xie and Shen families showed him a great deal of respect upon meeting him.

Precisely because of this, Shen Yuanzhu had always known the Jiang family desperately wanted to form a marriage alliance with the Xie family.

Only, the Jiang family's default candidate for the alliance was not Jiang Huansu, but her legitimate elder sister, Jiang Naizhen.

And the favored target was not Xie Xuchuan, but Xie Xuchuan's third uncle, Xie Jingyuan.

If word of Jiang Huansu's affair leaked and ruined this prospective marriage, it was hard to say what Old Master Jiang's attitude would be, but Jiang Naizhen would certainly not let Jiang Huansu off lightly.

Layer upon layer of tangled troubles, it was no wonder Xie Xuchuan was at his wit's end.

It was simply a pity that he had miscalculated.

To expect her and the Shen family to step forward and clean up the absolute mess he and Jiang Huansu had made was naive in the extreme.

Seeing Xie Xuchuan lingering and unwilling to leave, Shen Yuanzhu said: "Go on. Miss Jiang is pregnant and has a home she cannot return to; you'll need time to settle her."

"I..."

Xie Xuchuan hesitated for an instant. Yet after brief consideration, still feeling uneasy, he struggled through several internal conflicts before finally nodding.

"I... I'll go settle Huansu first, and I'll come find you tomorrow."

chapters.title: The Bright Pearl
chapters.content:
Jiang Huansu was currently recuperating and carrying her child at the Xie family's detached courtyard in the suburbs. When Xie Xuchuan arrived, she was sitting alone in the inner hall, lost in thought.

"Young Mistress, Young Master Xie is here."

Jiang Huansu turned her head, and as their eyes met, tears welled up in both of them simultaneously.

Having not seen each other for half a month, Jiang Huansu had grown much thinner. Her plain white cotton dress hung loosely on her frame. Just the simple act of standing up caused the world to go black before her eyes, sending waves of dizziness through her.

Looking at the pure white paper mourning flower pinned in her hair, Xie Xuchuan asked in a raspy voice, "How is your health these past few days?"

"Not bad."

She reached out to touch her lower abdomen, and her eyes reddened once more.

The two looked at each other in silence. After a long while, Jiang Huansu pointed to the chair beside her. "Did you return today?"

Xie Xuchuan let out a soft "Mn" and sat down in the seat furthest from her.

Though the detached courtyard was otherwise empty, all four doors of the inner hall stood wide open, as if the two were deliberately avoiding any suspicion.

Jiang Huansu was naturally fair and elegant, but recent sleepless nights and unease had cast a haggard, sickly pallor over her entire person.

As she poured tea for Xie Xuchuan, her hands shook so violently that she could barely lift the teapot.

"Let me."

Taking the teapot, Xie Xuchuan filled a cup for himself. "You're with child. Don't drink tea."

Jiang Huansu nodded, gently stroking her lower abdomen.

The sight of it wrenched Xie Xuchuan's heart, and he turned his head away, fighting back tears.

After a long pause, he said, "I've just returned from the Shen family."

Jiang Huansu let out a soft "Ah." "Did Shen Yuanzhu agree?"

Seeing Xie Xuchuan shake his head, her eyes grew red. "Let it be. It seems Yulin and I were simply cursed by fate."

At the mention of Cui Yulin, Jiang Huansu wept silently, while Xie Xuchuan felt a tight constriction in his chest.

Cui Yulin's father was the steward of the Xie family's weaving workshops. He and Cui Yulin had grown up together since childhood, and their bond was closer even than Xie Xuchuan's relationship with his own reclusive and temperamental twin brother.

No matter where Xie Xuchuan went, Cui Yulin was invariably by his side.

The Xie and Jiang families moved in the same circles, and through various comings and goings, Jiang Huansu and Cui Yulin had somehow developed secret feelings for one another.

Yet even though Jiang Huansu was merely a concubine-born daughter of the Jiang family, it was still impossible for her to be married down to Cui Yulin, who was little more than a half-servant of the Xie family.

Youthful romance burned all the brighter the more hopeless the path ahead appeared.

It wasn't until Jiang Huansu discovered she was pregnant that Cui Yulin and she panicked and rushed to find Xie Xuchuan.

Cui Yulin did not dare to go to the Jiang family to propose marriage. Once the matter failed and word got out that Jiang Huansu had lost her chastity before marriage, the Jiang family would certainly have no place for her.

Thus, Xie Xuchuan had come up with an idea for Cui Yulin.

At this thought, Xie Xuchuan's curled fingers tightened. Seeing the damp sweat marks he had squeezed into the fabric of his robes, he hurriedly forced his hand to relax.

"You needn't worry about Yuanzhu. She will agree."

Looking at Jiang Huansu's red and swollen eyes, Xie Xuchuan turned his face away. "This is a debt my wife and I owe you and Yulin. The child in your womb, I will raise him until he reaches adulthood."

Hearing this, Jiang Huansu lowered her gaze. "Being a woman, I understand a woman's heart better. Shen Yuanzhu does not know your hidden difficulties; she only believes that you betrayed her. Right now, she can only hate you.

"To ask her to agree to bring this child back into the Xie family, how easy do you think that is?"

Xie Xuchuan replied, "Once the dust settles and there are no more variables, I will explain it to Yuanzhu. She will understand."

But not now.

The child carried half of his own bloodline, and even getting him entered into the Xie family genealogy would be exceptionally difficult. If word leaked out, letting people know that the child in Jiang Huansu's womb had not the slightest connection to the Xie family, then no matter what, both the child and Jiang Huansu would face certain death.

He could not bear it, nor could he bring himself to turn a blind eye.

"Mn," Jiang Huansu murmured softly. A moment later, she casually remarked, "Shen Yuanzhu is in the middle of her anger right now. The more you try to explain, the more she will hate you. Instead of pressing her, you might as well go directly to Shen Yanhuai or Ye Yunyi."

Shen Yanhuai was Shen Yuanzhu's concubine-born elder half-brother, and Ye Yunyi was his wife.

Back then, Shen Mother had been married into the Shen family for many years without conceiving, prompting Shen Father to take a concubine who gave birth to Shen Yanhuai.

Twelve years later, the couple finally had Shen Yuanzhu.

After Shen Mother became pregnant, the couple had always hoped to produce a legitimate son to whom they could hand over the entirety of the Shen family's businesses. Little did they expect that a few years later, Shen Mother would fall gravely ill.

Left with no other choice, Shen Father proposed entering Shen Yanhuai into Shen Mother's registry so that he could legitimately inherit the Shen family fortune.

Shen Mother agreed, but on one condition presented to both Shen Father and the concubine.

Fearing that after her death the concubine would grow too powerful and incite Shen Father to mistreat Shen Yuanzhu, she forced the concubine to choose between her son's future or her own.

The very next day, Shen Yanhuai's biological mother hanged herself in her own room, and Shen Father also vowed never to remarry.

It was just a pity...

The events that followed were known to all. After driving the concubine to her death, Shen Mother did not die, but Shen Father passed away prematurely due to an accident.

Barely two years later, Shen Mother's grave illness finally overcame her, and she departed as well. Before her death, she arranged every possible fallback for Shen Yuanzhu.

Yet what of it?

In the span of a single night, Shen Yuanzhu still plummeted from being the cherished apple of the Shen family's eye to a helpless, "dust-covered pearl."

Jiang Huansu wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes, looking pitiful and forlorn. "As long as you agree to hand over the other portions of the *Xie Family Agricultural and Weaving Atlas* and the *Shen Family Dyeing Manual* to Shen Yanhuai, the Shen family will agree to back you up."

chapters.title: Wedding Gift
chapters.content:
"No."

Xie Xuchuan shook his head. "There must be another way."

Discussing the adoption of a legitimate son with Yuanzhu was an entirely different matter from bypassing Yuanzhu altogether to find Shen Yanhuai and having Shen Yanhuai coerce her into agreement.

He and Yuanzhu were to become husband and wife; a husband and wife had to consult one another on all matters, no matter what.

If he made a private deal with Shen Yanhuai and joined forces with him to coerce Yuanzhu, that would truly destroy the very foundation of their relationship.

Furthermore, under Shen Mother's meticulous scheming, the *Xie Family Agricultural and Weaving Atlas* and the *Shen Family Dyeing Manual* had remained out of Shen Yanhuai's hands for years.

This was the foundation Shen Mother had painstakingly plotted during her illness to secure Yuanzhu's future livelihood.

If he were to let Shen Mother's painstaking efforts go to waste...

Xie Xuchuan clenched his itching palms, not daring to dwell on the thought.

"It was presumptuous of me; I shouldn't have brought this up."

Jiang Huansu stroked her belly with a desolate smile. "I shouldn't shift the responsibility of this child onto your shoulders. You have protected me ever since Yulin died, that is already a kindness as vast as the heavens.

"How could I repay kindness with enmity now? In truth, I won't be able to hide this belly for much longer anyway. I might as well go home early and explain everything clearly to my father."

Wiping the tears from her cheeks, Jiang Huansu continued, "If Father shows mercy, I can openly raise the child I share with Yulin. If Father refuses, Yulin and I can become a pair of ghost spouses in the netherworld, that wouldn't be such a bad fate either."

Her fair, withered palm gently brushed across her lower abdomen, laden with lingering affection and reluctance.

"It's only that I've failed Yulin and Uncle Cui, cutting off the Cui family line."

Hot tears smashed onto the ground as Jiang Huansu murmured softly, "I am a person devoid of fortune. When you brought Yulin to meet me back then, I should never have let my heart be stirred..."

With just a few words, Xie Xuchuan turned pale as death.

He was not unaware that Jiang Huansu was accusing him of introducing the two of them, yet Xie Xuchuan did not dare to utter a single word of defense.

What floated up in his mind was the scene before he left for Huizhou, when Cui Yulin came to find him and told him that Huansu was pregnant.

Upon learning of Jiang Huansu's pregnancy, Cui Yulin had been both anxious and ecstatic.

Xie Xuchuan, however, had been deeply shocked, his heart filled with dissatisfaction toward Cui Yulin.

If Cui Yulin were a man of responsibility, he should not have let Jiang Huansu become secretly pregnant with his child without a title or status, leaving them stranded in such a dilemma.

Yet, looking at the brother who had grown up alongside him, crying and laughing as he declared he was going to be a father, Xie Xuchuan still could not bring himself to scold him.

"Xuchuan, I want to marry Huansu. You have no idea how badly I want to take her home as my wife."

Cui Yulin had grabbed his hand. "But I can't. Jiang Hong is simply a man who loves the rich, despises the poor, craves wealth, and chases status. He won't agree. With my status, how could he ever agree?"

Xie Xuchuan had said, "She is Huansu's father; you shouldn't speak of him like that."

With a light sigh, Xie Xuchuan had added, "Uncle Jiang is merely afraid that his daughter will entrust her life to the wrong person.

"As long as you make something of yourself and achieve accomplishments, I will ask my Mother to go to the Jiang family and propose marriage. The Jiang family will at least give Mother a modicum of face."

"Make something of myself and achieve accomplishments?"

Cui Yulin's eyes had been bloodshot. "You have the Xie family behind you, which is why you can speak of it so lightly. But for an ordinary person trying to carve out a career, it is as difficult as ascending to the heavens.

"Besides, Huansu doesn't have the time to wait for me to build a business from scratch. I can wait, but the child in her belly cannot."

"I do happen to have a method."

After thinking for a moment, Xie Xuchuan had said, "Half a month from now, a cargo ship from Taicang's Liujiagang is heading to the Western oceans to trade goods. In our current dynasty, everyone from civil and military officials down to commoners loves foreign goods; a single foreign striking clock can be exchanged for ten thousand liang of gold.

"I have some friendship with the Taicang Liu family. If you want to go, I can arrange for someone to put you on that ship.

"I will provide the capital; consider it a wedding gift from me to you and Huansu."

chapters.title: Opportunity
chapters.content:
"You mean to let me go out to sea?"

Cui Yulin shook his head frantically. "No, merchant ships are far too dangerous. Even if the profits are ten-thousandfold, they are bought by risking human lives.

"Right now, I cannot afford to make a single misstep. If something were to happen to me, what would become of Huansu and the child in her belly?"

Cui Yulin's repeated refusals stirred a flash of irritation in Xie Xuchuan.

"Then what do you propose to do? Just sit in front of me day after day, drowning your sorrows in alcohol? Wait until Huansu's belly grows large, and then push her in front of Uncle Jiang to face it alone?

"Going out to sea carries risks, but risk is often accompanied by opportunity. If you truly wish to marry Huansu, I will have someone send you to Taicang tonight.

"If you refuse to go, then never mention this matter in front of me again."

Xie Xuchuan had turned to leave, but Cui Yulin grabbed hold of him and wouldn't let go.

He was dead drunk, muttering incoherently about being an unfilial son and a bad brother, too cowardly to risk his own skin and unworthy of being a husband.

Seeing him make such a scene, Xie Xuchuan felt a lump of frustration in his chest and had money orders and three hundred bolts of cloud brocade sent to the Cui family's doorstep overnight.

Early the next morning, Cui Yulin looked at the courtyard full of cloud brocade, his eyes turning red.

Xie Xuchuan had told him, "Go ahead with peace of mind. I've inquired about it: the Liu family originally did indeed use standard commercial Fuchuan ships, but recently, they spent a massive sum to build a brand-new Guangchuan ship. It is said the entire vessel is built from iron-limber wood and is exceptionally sturdy."

Pointing to the cloud brocade on the ground, Xie Xuchuan had sighed, "I took these from Mother's private treasury. Take them with you first. Once you trade them for ten thousand liang of gold, you can grandly welcome Huansu through your doors.

"During the half year you are away, I will properly take care of Huansu and your child. When you return, I will hand them back to you safe and sound in every detail."

He had patted Cui Yulin's shoulder, and the two brothers had bid farewell with teary eyes.

Cui Yulin, he was the one who had personally sent him away onto that Liu family ship.

Yet no one knew that this seemingly indestructible giant vessel had weathered the winds and waves only to fall prey to Western pirates.

When the news arrived that the ship had been destroyed and all hands lost, it was the darkest moment of Xie Xuchuan's life.

"Xuchuan, I think I should return to the Jiang family today."

Seeing him lost in thought, Jiang Huansu stood up.

Her white garments fluttered in the wind. Frail and weak, she even stumbled back a few steps as she rose.

Xie Xuchuan hurriedly stood up. "Huansu, you... wait for me one more day. Rest assured..."

He pressed his lips together, a trace of stubbornness in his eyes.

Leaving behind a single sentence..."I will surely give you an explanation", he hurried away.

The young man's departure whipped up a cross breeze that brushed against the hem of Jiang Huansu's plain skirt, revealing the coarse hemp fabric underneath.

She and Cui Yulin had not formally married; they were not yet husband and wife, so she could not wear official mourning clothes. Yet in Jiang Huansu's heart, she was already a wife of the Cui family.

"Young Mistress..."

Zitang emerged from the room, carrying a bowl of warm meat broth to Jiang Huansu. "Young Mistress, you are carrying two lives now. Even for the sake of the little master, you must force yourself to eat something."

"Set it down."

Zitang nodded. Looking at Jiang Huansu's slender, fragile back, she choked out, "Young Mistress, do you think Young Master Xie will really bring the little master back to the Xie family and raise him as his legitimate son?"

"He will."

Jiang Huansu said, "Xuchuan is soft-hearted, and his bond with Yulin surpassed that of true brothers. Furthermore, going to Taicang was his idea... Whether out of guilt or to protect fraternal loyalty, he will ultimately see it through."

Zitang's eyes turned red. "Before Young Master Xie left for Huizhou, this servant heard that the First Madam had already chosen a husband for you, it seemed to be someone from a Huzhou silk-weaving background."

Yet how could her young mistress ever marry anyone now?

"Young Mistress, as the saying goes, people cool as soon as the tea is gone. Young Master Xie's guilt toward Young Master Cui can last for a moment, but not a lifetime. As times change and their fraternal bond fades, will Young Master Xie still be able to treat the little master as his own flesh and blood?"

Zitang advised earnestly, "Only if you stay by the little master's side can you firmly grasp Young Master Xie and the Xie family's businesses in your own hands.

"Young Mistress, right now, Young Master Xie is the best way out for you and the little master. Why not use this opportunity to latch onto the Xie family and marry Xie Xuchuan..."

chapters.title: New Mourning
chapters.content:
"Shut your mouth."

Jiang Huansu's eyes reddened. "Yulin's new mourning has barely begun, and already you harbor thoughts of making me pledge my allegiance to another? How could I possibly face Yulin if I did that?"

Cui Yulin had only boarded that merchant ship in order to marry her; he was not unaware of how great the risks of that journey were.

How could she have a clear conscience and immediately turn around to remarry while the man she loved had died on her account?

"Young Mistress... This servant didn't mean it that way."

Zitang supported Jiang Huansu with a heart full of distress. "This servant only feels sorry for you, Young Mistress. The First Madam has always looked down upon the concubines, and toward you she is also...

"The husband she has chosen for you is likely no good."

Besides, even if the husband chosen by the First Madam were decent, given her young mistress's current condition, it was utterly impossible for her to be safely married into another household.

It wasn't that Jiang Huansu didn't understand Zitang's meaning.

Choking back tears, she said, "I know you are doing this for my own good, but who knows the hardship I endure?

"How could I not know that the best way out right now is to seize this opportunity to enter the Xie family? Yet whenever I look at Xuchuan, my heart aches terribly."

She was not ignorant of the fact that Xie Xuchuan had sent Cui Yulin to sea for her own good, but that could not change the fact that Cui Yulin had been killed because of Xie Xuchuan.

She knew she shouldn't hate him, but she was truly not a magnanimous person.

Jiang Huansu lowered her head to look at her lower abdomen, tears falling in patters.

Seeing this, Zitang embraced her young mistress and wept along with her.

When the two of them had cried until they lacked the strength for more, Jiang Huansu finally stood up and ate a little food.

The meat broth had been first steamed then stewed, leaving it fresh, fragrant, smooth, and tender, yet Jiang Huansu held the spoon for a long time without moving.

Zitang carefully tended to her from the side, and it was only after a long while that she heard her young mistress speak in a soft voice: "I know the Xie family is the best path out, but..."

Jiang Huansu lowered her gaze. "The Xie family cannot do without the Shen family's dyeing manual, and the Shen family cannot do without the Xie family's looms and patterns. Even for the sake of business, Xuchuan and Shen Yuanzhu's engagement cannot be undone.

"And I have no intention of disrupting this marriage either."

"Young Mistress... At a time like this, you're still thinking of others?"

"It's not about thinking of others; rather, I hope Shen Yuanzhu marries Xie Xuchuan, and Shen Yuanzhu *must* marry Xie Xuchuan."

Jiang Huansu's face was etched with exhaustion, yet her hand resting on her lower abdomen was incomparably gentle. "Would ruining someone else's marriage not be creating bad karma? I must accumulate virtue for the child in my womb.

"Besides, only if Shen Yuanzhu marries Xie Xuchuan will the Xie family obtain the other half of the dyeing manual. Only then can the currently renowned Xie family cloud brocade reach even greater heights."

A single bolt of plain cloud brocade was worth a hundred and twenty liang, equal to a county magistrate's five-year salary, and colored cloud brocade dyed with the Shen family's secret methods could multiply that value severalfold.

It was said that the remaining half of the Shen family's dyeing manual contained rare, magnificent, and orthodox colors rarely seen in this world.

Therefore, no one could possibly destroy the engagement between Shen Yuanzhu and Xie Xuchuan, nor would the Xie and Shen families ever permit it.

And since Xie Xuchuan had promised to adopt the child she shared with Yulin as his legitimate heir, then naturally, a portion of the Xie family's future fortunes would belong to her child.

This was what Xie Xuchuan owed Yulin and her.

The child belonging to her and Yulin was entirely worthy and deserving of it.

Jiang Huansu scooped up a spoonful of the meat broth and ate it bit by bit.

A wave of warmth flowed into her belly, making Jiang Huansu feel slightly more comfortable.

She looked at Zitang and pondered for a moment. "Don't worry, I will stay at the Xie family, and I will not be separated from my child."

Shen Yuanzhu was gentle and weak by nature, pure and innocent, completely devoid of scheming, and had been trained by her sister-in-law to be as timid as a quail.

As long as the girl married into the Xie family, she would have a way to pry the other half of the Shen family's dyeing manual out of Shen Yuanzhu's mouth.

This was what Xie Xuchuan owed her, and as Xie Xuchuan's wife, Shen Yuanzhu would have to bear this sin as well.

Wiping away the tears at the corners of her eyes, Jiang Huansu instructed, "Pack up the things in the detached courtyard properly. Tomorrow morning, go look for Xie Xuchuan and tell him I am returning to the Jiang family to confess my faults to my father."

"Young Mistress..."

Zitang wanted to say more, but Jiang Huansu waved her hand to cut her off. "If he takes action, then pay it no mind. If he remains indifferent, help me deliver a calling card to Shen Yuanzhu's sister-in-law."

Zitang was right: Yulin had just passed away, and Xie Xuchuan was currently filled with guilt.

But as time passed and that guilt faded, to what extent he would still be able to follow through was hard to say.

Therefore, she had to strike while the iron was hot, to let everything settle into dust with no room for reversal.

chapters.title: Resolute
chapters.content:
After Xie Xuchuan left, Shen Yuanzhu stayed in her room to check the account books.

Before her mother passed away, she had left her a considerable dowry, including clothing, accessories, furniture, utensils, and gold, silver, and jewels.

However, many of these items were kept in the Shen family storehouse, and over the years, her sister-in-law, Ye Yunyi, had taken quite a few of them under the guise of "borrowing" or "exchanging."

Shen Yuanzhu was young at the time, and apart from her wet nurse who never left her side, any other attending servants had been dismissed by Ye Yunyi.

With no one to protect Shen Yuanzhu, her losses were substantial.

Fortunately, these were not the main treasures left by Madam Shen.

Important items such as land deeds, agricultural property, shop ownership, and contracts with embroidery masters were all held tightly in Shen Yuanzhu's own hands.

Among them, the Xiecui Workshop was the true priceless treasure worth ten thousand pieces of gold that Madam Shen had left to her.

The Xiecui Workshop appeared to be an ordinary textile shop, but in reality, it was capable of self-production and self-sufficiency.

Inside the workshop, there were weaving and dyeing rooms, including twenty sets of three-spindle treadle spinning wheels, as well as two large water-powered spinning wheels capable of producing a hundred pounds of light silk daily.

There were four flower-pattern looms capable of weaving a hundred different patterns, alongside countless dyeing vats, copper pots, and printing plates.

There were even several secret dye recipes that even Shen Yanhuai knew nothing about.

Part of the reason for her poor relationship with her brother and sister-in-law was that over the years, Ye Yunyi had never been able to coax these assets out of her to claim them as her own.

The manager of the Xiecui Workshop, and the nominal master facing the outside world, was Shen Yuanzhu's foster brother, Luo Qing, who was the son of her wet nurse, Madam Luo.

Now that Shen Yuanzhu had grown up, these businesses had been returned to her hands.

Shen Yuanzhu checked the accounts page by page, as calm as if Xie Xuchuan had never visited the Shen household today.

While she could sit still, Ling'er found it unbearable.

Dropping down heavily beside Shen Yuanzhu, Ling'er said, "Oh, my dear young miss, how can you still have the heart to check accounts?

"That Jiang Huansu already has Young Master Xie's bun in her belly! Why aren't you thinking of a way out?"

"What way is there to think of?"

Putting down the account book, Shen Yuanzhu picked up a white sugar cake and popped it into her mouth, her cheeks bulging slightly as she chewed.

"Think of how to stop Young Master Xie from bringing that child into the Xie family! If he really brings Jiang Huansu and her child into the Xie family, what will you have to rely on in the future, Miss?"

After the passing of the master and mistress, the entire Shen family had been handed over to Shen Yanhuai.

Though the Shen family could not be called immensely wealthy, they could certainly be described as a grand household with vast estates. Consequently, Shen Yanhuai was often busy outside and rarely returned home.

Even when he did return, it was mostly to put on the airs of a head of the household and scold her young miss.

Ling'er had originally thought that once the young miss survived her coming-of-age ceremony and married into the Xie family, her path would be smooth sailing forever. But who could have imagined...

Seeing Shen Yuanzhu eating sweetly and acting as though none of this concerned her, Ling'er let out a cry and burst into tears.

"Good Ling'er, stop crying."

Shen Yuanzhu chewed with bulging cheeks and swallowed the sugar cake in her mouth: "Is the marriage engagement between the Xie and Shen families something Xie Xuchuan alone can decide?

"Besides, even without today's incident, he was hardly someone to be relied upon in the long run."

Raising her hand to wave her fingertips, Shen Yuanzhu said, "As long as I hold half of the Shen family's dye recipes in my hands, Xie Xuchuan will never dare to bypass me and act recklessly. That is my true reliance."

It might look like she was depending on the Xie family, but wasn't the Xie family equally coveting the secret recipes in her hands?

Right now, the Xie family was only a step away from becoming merchants to the imperial court, and that final step to the heavens was held right in her grasp.

She and the Xie family were merely using each other.

Therefore, Shen Yuanzhu was not afraid of Jiang Huansu or the child in her belly.

"You are wise, Miss. You will live well no matter where you go..."

Madam Luo looked at Shen Yuanzhu with eyes full of heartache. "It's just that matters of marriage aren't entirely about interests. In the past, I approved of Young Master Xie because he showed genuine sincerity toward the young miss.

"But now that he has betrayed her before marriage, what kind of behavior is that?

"And judging by his resolute attitude today, I'm afraid his heart is set on bringing that child into the family.

"If he insists on doing this, what will you do, Miss?"

---

chapters.title: Giving Up
chapters.content:
Hearing this, Shen Yuanzhu fell silent.

Her room was filled with many little trinkets, all gifts given to her by Xie Xuchuan over the years.

To say she wasn't sad would be a lie, but she had long anticipated today's outcome.

She simply hadn't expected that Xie Xuchuan's heart would change even before they were married.

Shen Yuanzhu stroked her heart, which twitched with a momentary pain, then muttered and shook her head: "If he insists, then so be it."

"So be it? What do you mean by 'so be it'?"

Ling'er widened her eyes in sheer terror.

Madam Luo said, "Naturally, she means calling off the marriage."

Wiping away a crumb of pastry from the corner of Shen Yuanzhu's lips, Madam Luo sighed, "Impregnating another woman before marriage already proves that this young man lacks character.

"Let alone the fact that taking Jiang Huansu in as a concubine is already absurd beyond measure.

"To say nothing of Young Master Xie's desire to register that illegitimate spawn under the young miss's name? To publicly humiliate our young miss like this, he is by no means a good match."

And other things aside, Xie Xuchuan had specifically come up with this scheme to register an illegitimate child as legitimate.

How many years had her own mistress pined away in sorrow because of Shen Yanhuai?

Before Xie Xuchuan was even married, he was using such matters to pierce the young miss's heart...

Madam Luo clenched her palms, filled with indignation.

Hearing this, Shen Yuanzhu nodded as well.

Her parents had also been deeply in love back then, but later on, her father had still taken a concubine.

Not only did he father Shen Yanhuai with the concubine, but he also conceived Shen Yuanqiong with her while her mother was still observing the confinement period after childbirth.

If Shen Yanhuai was a thorn in her mother's eye, then Shen Yuanqiong was a thorn in her mother's heart.

It was only after Shen Yuanqiong was born that her mother began preparing her dowry and secretly keeping the Xiecui Workshop.

A loving couple ultimately ended up with nothing left but vigilance and sighs, which was why her mother had taught her from a very young age that only gold and silver would never betray you.

Clutching tightly to gold and silver meant one would always have a way out.

Seeing Shen Yuanzhu lost in thought, Madam Luo continued, "Right now, the Xie family looks to be at the height of its prosperity, but in reality, hidden troubles lurk beneath.

"As the eldest grandson of the primary branch, Xie Xuchuan has a twin brother whom almost no one has ever seen. This in itself is unusual.

"When the mistress arranged the marriage between the young miss and the Xie family back then, she remarked that there must be something abnormal about Xie Qi.

"The primary branch has its hidden secrets, while the Xie family's second branch acts like a pair of prodigal wastrel spendthrifts straight out of a storybook, jumping around the chamber of commerce, scrambling to show off, and notorious for being tricky and difficult to deal with.

"The third branch's Xie Jingyuan is indeed a good and promising man, but unfortunately, born into the third branch, he is destined never to take over the Xie family's businesses."

Xie Xuchuan's father, Xie Boyu, was simply too mediocre for the head of the primary branch.

Xie Boyu could only maintain the status quo; he could never carry the Xie family's foundation forward to greater glory.

Things might have been better if Xie Jingyuan were to take over the Xie family, but alas, he was still young, and the Xie family had no rules about dividing the family estate.

When Xie Jingyuan eventually married and had children in the future, who knew if he would still be able to endure his mediocre elder brother holding the absolute power of the Xie family and keeping him suppressed for a lifetime?

"Xie Boyu is mediocre himself, and the son he raised is utterly muddle-headed. A primary branch incapable of holding up the household..."

Madam Luo shook her head. "Within ten years, storms will surely rise within the Xie family."

After Madam Shen passed away, it was Madam Luo who personally educated Shen Yuanzhu. Though Madam Luo was merely a wet nurse, she possessed long-term vision and deep insight into the ways of the world.

Under her guidance, Shen Yuanzhu had become exceptionally shrewd.

Everything Madam Luo said was something Shen Yuanzhu had already considered before meeting Xie Xuchuan.

Propping her chin in her hand, she spoke with a lack of enthusiasm: "If Xie Xuchuan insists on registering that child as his legitimate heir, our marriage can only be called off.

"The Xie family's second and third branches are eyeing them like tigers eyeing their prey, yet he has buried such a massive hidden danger for himself. This truly shows that this man is..."

Lowering her eyelids, Shen Yuanzhu felt gloomy and swallowed the words "utterly foolish," replacing them with "naive."

Her marriage into the Xie family was intended to leverage the Xie family's influence to develop the Xiecui Workshop.

Having genuine affection for Xie Xuchuan was merely the icing on the cake for this union. Without affection, she could still become the eldest grandson's wife of the Xie family and claim the Xie family's Agricultural and Weaving Atlas.

However, of all the things Xie Xuchuan could plot, he had to plot against her money and her businesses. That was truly intolerable.

Seeing how unhurried Shen Yuanzhu and Madam Luo were, Ling'er slapped her thigh: "The two of you speak so lightly of this, but is the marriage engagement between the Xie and Shen families really something so easily called off..."

---

chapters.title: Candidates
chapters.content:
Shen Yuanzhu stroked her chin and muttered, "The marriage engagement between the Xie and Shen families cannot be casually altered, but that doesn't mean we can't change the candidate."

"You want to change your husband?!"

Ling'er waved her hands frantically, "We can't! Absolutely not!"

Madam Luo snorted, "Why ever not? Since Xie Xuchuan dared to commit such an act, why shouldn't our young miss change her groom?"

"Oh, Granny Luo, please don't add to the young miss's troubles."

Ling'er shook her head like a rattle-drum, "Miss, we've all seen how Xie family's young master has treated you over the years.

"It must be that Jiang Huansu who seduced Young Master Xie and led him astray. In time, he will surely see the young miss's good qualities and return to you.

"The feelings the two of you have built up over so many years cannot be fake.

"And as the young miss just said, the marriage engagement between the Xie and Shen families cannot be broken. Besides Xie Xuchuan, where else in the Xie family is there a more suitable candidate?

"Among the unmarried men of the Xie family who are of age, there is only the young master's third uncle, Xie Jingyuan, but he has already reached the age of twenty (ruoguan), making him a full five years older than you.

"Then there is Young Master Xie's elusive twin younger brother, Xie Qi.

"Yet you've been engaged to the Xie family for so long and have never even laid eyes on Xie Qi once. For all you know, this man could be mad, stupid, sickly, or disabled.

"As for any others left, they are mere toddlers of three or five years old. Tell me, where else is there a candidate to switch to?"

Ling'er earnestly tried to persuade her, "Miss, Young Master Xie and Jiang Huansu acted absurdly, but the Xie family's Dowry Madam and Madam Xie are reasonable people.

"Tomorrow, tomorrow you should go to the Xie family and ask Old Madam Xie to make decisions for you.

"The old madam is fond of you; if you go and plead with her, she will definitely deal with Jiang Huansu.

"At that time..."

Ling'er gritted her teeth, a trace of ruthlessness flashing across her face, "At worst, a bowl of abortifacient medicine can be forced down her throat, and there will be no more obstacles between you and Young Master Xie."

"Silly Ling'er."

Shen Yuanzhu's skin was delicate and fair; simply rubbing her chin had already caused a patch of crimson to bloom there.

Indifferently, she poked Ling'er's forehead: "The reason my wet nurse and I even considered changing the candidate isn't because of Jiang Huansu at all. It is because this incident proves that Xie Xuchuan's aptitude is far too poor."

If Xie Xuchuan were a clever man, he wouldn't have engaged in such behavior with Jiang Huansu right when their marriage date was approaching.

Even if he were momentarily blinded by lust, a resolute person wouldn't have brought the matter straight to her doorstep.

Since the other party had broached the subject with her, it at least showed that Xie Xuchuan, at that exact moment, had made up his mind to register that child as his legitimate heir and inherit the Xie family's estate.

A foolish young master driven by lust, utterly devoid of backbone, resolution, or steadiness, and prone to wild delusions, no matter how much she used to like him, he was definitely not a good confidant to walk hand-in-hand with through life.

She wouldn't even have hired such a person to be a shop manager at the Xiecui Workshop, let alone take him as her husband to spend a lifetime holding hands.

Realizing that she had failed to see through Xie Xuchuan's character for all these years, Shen Yuanzhu angrily rubbed her rounded cheeks.

"I could indeed go find Madam Xie, but even if I did, what of it?

"A fool won't suddenly become smart overnight. If he commits something absurd and we run to Madam Xie this time, what about the next time, or the time after that?"

Shen Yuanzhu said wistfully, "A mess like this is endless."

She didn't want to end up like her mother, spending the latter half of her life entirely focused on how to protect her own children and remaining constantly on guard against the man sharing her pillow.

Her husband might be ordinary and unremarkable, but he could never be a drag on her.

"That may be true..."

Ling'er looked at Shen Yuanzhu with heartbreak, tears falling down her cheeks. "But Miss, have you ever considered that no matter who you marry in the Xie family, you can never escape Young Master Xie...

"You and Young Master Xie grew up as childhood sweethearts and have been engaged for over a decade. Not to mention the Xie family, but who throughout the entire Suzhou Prefecture doesn't know about this golden match between the Xie and Shen families?"

"Who doesn't know that your affection for Young Master Xie is deep?

"No man can accept his wife having been previously engaged to another, especially since, Miss, you would be a woman betrothed twice..."

"You... if you choose another husband and remarry in the future, I'm afraid the new groom might hear gossip and harbor resentment, and won't treat you well..."

---

chapters.title: Disappointment
chapters.content:
"Silly Ling'er."

Seeing Ling'er cry, the rims of Shen Yuanzhu's eyes turned red as well.

She was, after all, just a young girl who had newly reached her fifteenth year. To say she had no worries whatsoever about the sudden twists in her marriage would be a lie, but Shen Yuanzhu looked much further ahead.

"If I lived only for romance, I would indeed be plagued by trouble, but I am different from ordinary people."

Shen Yuanzhu pressed her lips together, her round eyes bright and clear, devoid of any confusion or lingering reluctance.

"Old Madam Xie and Madam Xie like me not because of Xie Xuchuan, but because of the dye recipes in my hands.

"This is the bargaining chip I can use to negotiate with the Xie family.

"The marriage contract cannot be broken. No matter which member of the Xie family marries me, regardless of how unhappy they might feel in their hearts, they must still revere me and treat me with utmost respect."

"As long as the dye recipes in my hands have not been fully disclosed to the Xie family, the Xie family will not dare to do anything to me."

Madam Luo stroked Ling'er's long hair, gently coaxing her: "Changing the marriage candidate is not such a simple matter. Over these next few days, we'll see whether Xie Xuchuan can come to his senses.

"If he insists on walking blindly down this dark path to the end, it won't just be the young miss talking about changing candidates, I have plenty of ways to make the Xie family bring up the annulment first.

"If the Xie family speaks of it first, then it is they who broke the marriage contract. When the young miss enters their doors later, they will only coax and revere her all the more."

Glancing at Shen Yuanzhu, Madam Luo remarked, "Actually, this old servant felt long ago that Xie Xuchuan wasn't a good match for the young miss. Xie Boyu is mediocre in character, so how exceptional could his son possibly be?

"Acknowledging him all these years was merely because I saw he still held a shred of genuine sincerity toward the young miss.

"Yet today I've learned just how cheap that sincerity is.

"Seeing how well he treated the young miss, who could have known how he treated Jiang Huansu behind closed doors?

"Now that a child is already on the way, heaven knows when those two rolled into bed together."

Madam Luo's expression was stern, her tone full of resentment.

"You felt Young Master Xie wasn't a good match long ago, Granny?" Ling'er blinked. "Then who do you think is suitable?"

"Why ask such..."

"Xie Jingyuan."

Shen Yuanzhu interrupted Madam Luo. "My foster brother has dealt with Xie Jingyuan at the Xiecui Workshop and says he is a genius at commerce."

No one knew that the Xiecui Workshop was her private property, and naturally, no one could have guessed that this newly rising star of a workshop belonged privately to the eldest young miss of the Shen family.

The Xiecui Workshop had business partnerships with both the Xie and Shen families, so Luo Qing was far from a stranger to Xie Jingyuan.

Thinking of Xie Jingyuan, Shen Yuanzhu tapped her chin with her fingertip, lowered her eyelids, and fell into deep thought: "The Xie family's businesses are only handed over to the primary branch. Xie Boyu is mediocre, but Xie Jingyuan has means; in time, his ambition will inevitably become too great to suppress.

"If the two of us were to marry, I could take the opportunity to instigate him, prompting him to withdraw from the Xie family's general assets and hand a portion of the Xiecui Workshop over to his own control.

"Although the Xie family has ancestral instructions against dividing the family estate, hearts are not united, and the day when they stage a drama of brothers turning against each other won't be far off. At that time, I will..."

Before Shen Yuanzhu could finish speaking, Ling'er was so frightened that she hurriedly pinched her mouth shut.

"Miss!"

Ling'er turned red with anxiety. "You... you... if words like these get out, you'll be drowned in a pig cage! How could you even say such a thing?!"

Madam Luo was also startled by Shen Yuanzhu.

She did indeed view Xie Jingyuan more favorably, but how could anyone dare to voice such a brazen thought out loud?

Madam Luo beat her chest in dismay: "Oh, Miss! These words cannot be spoken! You are good at everything, but your mind is so consumed by money that you cast everything else aside.

"Such words must never, ever be uttered again."

For a nephew's wife to harbor thoughts about her unmarried fiancé's third uncle, if anyone overheard that, she would immediately slam her head against the floor and die to atone for her sins to the mistress in the netherworld.

Shen Yuanzhu moved her lips, and seeing the heartbroken expressions on Ling'er and Madam Luo's faces, she let out a couple of soft whimpers.

"Miss, I'll let go, but you must not spout such nonsense again, do you hear?"

Shen Yuanzhu nodded, agreeing to the condition.

This episode frightened Madam Luo and Ling'er so badly that they dared not utter another word on the subject.

Their silence made Shen Yuanzhu feel inexplicably stifled.

It wasn't until late at night before sleep that she hid under the quilts and cried silently for a long while, finally falling into a heavy sleep out of sheer exhaustion.

After a restless night, Shen Yuanzhu woke up somewhat late the next day.

Half-asleep and half-awake, she saw Ling'er pull back the gauze bed curtains, trembling all over with anger.

"Miss!"

Seeing her sit up, Ling'er wailed, "Miss, Xie Xuchuan has sent a formal visiting card to the house! It's not for you, it's for Ye Yunyi!

"He... he is a scoundrel! He must have seen that the young miss wouldn't agree, so he went to Ye Yunyi and Shen Yanhuai, hoping those two would pressure you into taking that bastard child back into the Xie family!

"He is truly... truly going too far!"

chapters.title: Sister-in-law
chapters.content:
Shen Yuanzhu opened her drowsy eyes and stared blankly for a long time.

Seeing her in a daze, Ling'er said, "Miss, you must go to the Xie family quickly and stop Young Master Xie."

With that, she picked up a set of clothes and placed them before Shen Yuanzhu.

"With your temperament, so clumsy and rash, Nanny will be scolding you for lacking manners in a moment."

Rising slowly, Shen Yuanzhu stood before the washstand, rinsed her mouth with green salt, and carefully washed her face.

Once properly dressed and groomed, she pulled Ling'er to the bronze mirror and placed a white jade comb into her hand.

Although Ling'er was anxious and furious, she combed Shen Yuanzhu's hair with exceptional gentleness, not a single strand pulled out.

"Miss..."

"I want white porridge and silver-thread rolls for breakfast; tell the small kitchen to send them over."

Ling'er swung her arms in anxious exasperation, yet obediently went to bring the breakfast.

"Miss, aren't you going to stop Young Master Xie?"

Wiping the corner of her lips leisurely, Shen Yuanzhu sighed softly. "Since Xie Xuchuan has gone as far as my sister-in-law's, it means that no matter what my thoughts are, he is determined to bring that child into the Xie family.

"Even if I go to stop him, it will do no good. Better to eat and drink my fill first, and deal with troublesome people later."

Luo Shi walked in from outside just in time to catch those words.

She said, "Miss is right; no matter how huge the matter is, it cannot compare to Miss's food and clothing.

"Xie Xuchuan is already at the manor. Miss should go together to take a look, to see what kind of nonsense he can spout."

Go and see Xie Xuchuan's duplicity with her own eyes, hear his words of betrayal with her own ears.

Once she saw and heard them, her young lady would be able to give up her heart sooner and rush toward a different, brilliant future.

Luo Shi had a fire in her heart, so her expression carried a hint of sternness.

Shen Yuanzhu nodded obediently and walked out with Luo Shi.

The moment the three of them turned out of the hanging flower gate, they saw Ye Yunyi and Shen Yuanqiong walking toward the main hall ahead, talking and laughing.

Ling'er pouted toward Luo Shi, and Shen Yuanzhu opened her mouth to call out to Ye Yunyi.

"Greetings, Sister-in-law, Sister."

"Did Yuanzhu sleep well today?"

Upon seeing Shen Yuanzhu, Ye Yunyi wore a face full of delight.

Shen Yuanzhu let her look her up and down, appearing extremely obedient and docile.

"I slept well, thank you for your concern, Sister-in-law."

Hearing this, Ye Yunyi smiled coquettishly. "Our Yuanzhu is truly endearing."

With that, she even reached out to stroke Shen Yuanzhu's shoulder, looking exceedingly warm and solicitous.

Shen Yuanqiong stood to one side, a half-smile on her face, carrying quite a bit of aloof arrogance.

"I heard the gatekeeper say early this morning that the Xie family boy came to visit me. Does Yuanzhu know what it's about?"

Her tone carried teasing. "Ever since returning from Huizhou, Xuchuan has come to the house two days in a row; one can tell how tightly our Yuanzhu has tied down Xuchuan's heart."

Shen Yuanqiong disdainfully turned her head away, while Shen Yuanzhu merely smiled blankly.

When she didn't answer, Ye Yunyi wasn't annoyed either. She simply stretched out two fingers and pinched the hem of Shen Yuanzhu's dress.

"I've seen you wear this dress a few times; is it from last spring? It doesn't look new anymore. Now that your wedding is approaching, it's not proper to wear old clothes from the past."

Ye Yunyi wore a look of heartache. "If the Xie family finds out, they'll think the household is stinting on you. This afternoon, I'll have the embroiderers from the shop come to the house to make a few new sets for you and Yuanqiong."

Shen Yuanzhu agreed with a sweet smile, and Ye Yunyi continued, "One or two sets won't do. A new bride going to her husband's family must have all her clothes for the first year or two prepared. I think four pieces per season for spring, summer, autumn, and winter would be good?

"And as for the colors, as many as possible, and those bright and dazzling ones. After all, we can't let the husband's family look down on you.

"And the jewelry...

"With the wedding imminent, Sister-in-law will go to the storehouse to pick out some valuable ones that can hold their own.

"The Xie family is wealthy, and our Yuanzhu is marrying into the eldest branch; it wouldn't do to be outdone..."

Ye Yunyi chattered on endlessly, and Shen Yuanzhu crisply chimed in with "Thank you, Sister-in-law" and "Sister-in-law is so fond of me" at every turn.

Ling'er, upon seeing this scene, was so angry she twisted her handkerchief into a wrinkled ball.

It was one thing to make snide remarks about her young lady hooking up with Xie Xuchuan, but she even had the nerve to talk about picking valuable jewelry from the storehouse for the young lady.

Ninety-nine percent of the gold and silver jewelry in the Shen family storehouse were dowry items left behind for the young lady by her late mistress. What did Shen Yanhuai and Shen Yuanqiong's birth mother leave behind?

Now, coming from Ye Yunyi's mouth, it sounded as though all those things were being bestowed upon the young lady out of her magnanimity as a sister-in-law.

And talking about making clothes, ever since Ye Yunyi married in, she had repeatedly stolen the fine fabrics the mistress had saved for the young lady from the storehouse, all under the pretext of making clothes, shoes, and socks for the young lady.

Calling it making clothes for the young lady, but actually stealing the young lady's dowry to pad her own and Shen Yuanqiong's prestige.

***

chapters.title: Returning Money
chapters.content:
Ling'er glared hatefully at Shen Yuanqiong, who wore a look of disdain, her heart burning with righteous fury.

Glancing over the next moment, she saw that the East Pearl hairpin worn in Shen Yuanqiong's hair looked exceedingly familiar.

She frowned and thought about it for quite a while before remembering this hairpin.

This hairpin was clearly the birthday gift the master had given to the mistress while he was still alive.

Such a large, warm, and translucent East Pearl, not even the entire Suzhou Prefecture could find a second one, yet now it was shining brightly on Shen Yuanqiong's head!

Ling'er stamped her foot in anger and wanted to step forward, but was pulled back by Luo Shi.

She pouted anxiously, but Luo Shi steadily pushed her behind herself.

It wasn't that Shen Yuanzhu didn't see what Shen Yuanqiong was wearing on her head. Her gaze lingered on that pearl hairpin for only a brief moment before she turned her head away as if she had seen nothing at all, still walking affectionately alongside Ye Yunyi.

"Sister-in-law is truly good to Yuanzhu."

"Look at you talking. If Sister-in-law isn't good to you, who should she be good to? Both you and Yuanqiong are the apple of Sister-in-law's eye."

Ye Yunyi pulled Shen Yuanzhu's hand, her eyes showing reluctance to part. "Actually, even if you don't say it, Sister-in-law knows what Xuchuan came here for today; it must be to discuss the marriage between the two of you.

"Thinking that you'll be married off in a few days, this heart of Sister-in-law's..."

Lifting a hand to press against her chest, Ye Yunyi touched the corners of her eyes for non-existent tears. "Is so terribly reluctant."

"My Yuanzhu is gentle and docile. I've raised you like a daughter for so long, raised you to be so plump and sleek. I only wonder if you'll be as carefree at your husband's house as you are now."

Shen Yuanzhu said affectionately, "I'm afraid it will be hard. After all, there is no one else in the world who treats Yuanzhu as dearly as Sister-in-law."

"Knowing that Sister-in-law is good to you is enough, as long as your elder brother is good to you too. Your elder brother, though he doesn't say it, misses you two the most in his heart."

Shen Yuanzhu smiled with her eyes curved into crescents, but remained silent.

"Oh, look at my head; I forgot to tell you something."

Ye Yunyi tugged at Shen Yuanzhu's hand and patted it gently. "Do you remember the other day when my maternal younger brother dyed the wrong batch of goods?"

Ye Yunyi's maternal family specialized in cotton cloth and was considered an old shop with a fair bit of reputation in Songjiang.

However, they were still three parts inferior compared to the Shen family, so the Ye family could also be said to eat depending on the expressions of the Xie and Shen families.

Ever since Ye Yunyi married into the Shen family, she had frequently used the Shen family's foundation to subsidize her maternal family.

Hearing her bring it up now, Shen Yuanzhu tilted her head and said, "I remember. Sister-in-law took three thousand taels of silver from me back then for the emergency. Can it be returned now?"

Ye Yunyi's expression faded a little. "That's right. My brother passed through Suzhou Prefecture the other day and returned the money. I've already entered it into the public accounts."

Hearing this, Shen Yuanzhu revealed a faint smile.

The silver wheedled out of her hands through soft persistence was turned around and reported as returned to the public funds. She used to think Ye Yunyi was merely a bit petty, but now she appeared downright greedy.

Seeing that she didn't speak, Ye Yunyi continued, "You also know that the Shen family's business in recent years falls far short of when Father was alive.

"Ever since your mother passed away, many of the rare color vats in the Shen family dyeing mill were sealed up. The most profitable business was cut off, and the family business naturally goes from bad to worse.

"On the other hand, the Xie family..."

Ye Yunyi sighed heavily. "Using the Shen family's dyeing recipes, their business has grown larger and larger over the years. It truly makes one anxious.

"You tell me, our own family comes from a background of dyeing mills, yet the colors we can make now are stubbornly inferior to the Xie family's. How can this make one feel at ease?

"Your brother runs all over the place following the chamber of commerce for the sake of business, and only I, his wife, feel the heartache for him.

"Outsiders use the Shen family's craftsmanship to line their pockets with wealth, yet we ourselves cannot use our own things. If word gets out, we'll be cursed as people who eat inside and out."

Ye Yunyi lifted her eyes, looked at Shen Yuanzhu, and said, "Yuanzhu, don't you think so?"

***

chapters.title: Settling Accounts
chapters.content:
"If word gets out, people will definitely say we're eating inside and out."

Shen Yuanzhu's ears were practically growing calluses from hearing Ye Yunyi say this. It was nothing more than an attempt to force her to hand over the Shen family's dyeing recipes and restart the rare color vats.

While speaking, Shen Yuanzhu nodded heavily, her clear, starry eyes filled with innocence. "So, Sister-in-law...

"You must stop subsidizing that younger brother of yours. Although I should also respect Elder Brother Ye, I must say he really isn't cut out for business.

"Just Elder Brother using his private money to plug the holes for him, hasn't it happened two or three times already? If not for Elder Brother Ye, how could Elder Brother be working so hard?"

Shen Yuanzhu blinked, slightly wrinkling her nose, her voice soft and tender. "Sister-in-law, you are so good, I don't want people to call you someone who eats inside and out, a thief who steals from the family."

Seeing Ye Yunyi's unsightly expression, Shen Yuanzhu's tone was full of worry. "Elder Brother is out there and I don't even know if he's eating and sleeping well. If it weren't for those accounts, Elder Brother could have rested for another two or three months."

Hearing Shen Yuanzhu speak thus, Shen Yuanqiong also became dissatisfied.

It was just that she didn't know what to say, so she lowered her eyes and pretended not to hear.

Ye Yunyi smiled with a stiff face. "Sister-in-law knows Yuanzhu feels heartache for your elder brother."

Shen Yuanzhu was born delicate and cute. Because of her tender age, her cheeks carried soft, fleshy baby fat, making her look round and plump without any sign of shrewdness.

Ye Yunyi knew she wasn't a clever person.

If Shen Yuanzhu had any brains, all that hard cash wouldn't have passed into her hands.

Suppressing her displeasure, Ye Yunyi let out an "Oh!" "You're a young lady about to be married off anyway; why talk to you about the family's hardships? It would only make you worry for nothing.

"These things shouldn't be managed by a young lady in her boudoir. Even though there's no silver in the accounts, Sister-in-law will definitely not treat you short when you get married."

Ye Yunyi put her arm around Shen Yuanzhu, acting all affectionate. "As your sister-in-law, I will definitely make sure you marry in splendor. Not only will the storehouse provide a portion of the dowry, but Sister-in-law will also add to your dowry extra.

"When you and Yuanqiong get married, how about Sister-in-law gives you two thousand taels each?"

Ling'er rolled her eyes straight into the back of her head upon hearing this.

Cheated three thousand taels from the Miss, and gave two thousand taels back as dowry.

Calculating that inside and out, Ye Yunyi still made a profit of one thousand taels from the Miss.

Shen Yuanqiong smiled gently at the side.

Both she and Ye Yunyi were decked out in luxurious and fine goods from head to toe, looking even more precious than the daughters of official families.

It made Ling'er inwardly curse the two of them for colluding together.

Her young lady, however, was able to keep her composure, still smiling and tilting her head to say "Thank you, Sister-in-law" at a time like this.

The three sisters-in-law walked toward the main hall, talking and laughing. Ling'er lagged behind, so angry she wanted to run up and tear both their mouths open.

Seeing this, Luo Shi said, "Your temperament is far too volatile."

Ling'er snorted. "It's those two things whose actions are too clumsy."
