"Since you know they're clumsy, why bother wrangling with them every time? The Miss's life is vast and bright; how can she waste time worrying over petty people and petty matters every day?"

"They stole so much stuff from the Miss, and we're just going to let it go?"

Hearing this, Luo Shi let out a "pfft" of laughter. "Do you think our young lady is a generous person?"

"..."

Ling'er pouted.

Her young lady was good at everything, except she was like a refined abacus bead, calculating accounts with absolute clarity.

Over the years, aside from the loyal servants left to the Miss by the late mistress and the hands in the shop, she had never seen anyone take advantage of her young lady.

Right now, Ye Yunyi and Shen Yuanqiong were laughing merrily, but things might not be so certain in the future.

Pondering for a moment, Ling'er lowered her voice. "Did the Miss figure out a plan long ago to punish that Ye Yunyi?"

Luo Shi poked her on the forehead. "Chicken-feather-and-garlic-skin accounts cannot be cleared one by one; we'll just settle the general ledger another day. You should learn a thing or two from the Miss."

"What on earth is the plan..."

"How would I know? Don't ask anymore. Xie Xuchuan has arrived; go first and see what kind of flower this ungrateful wretch can spout today."

***

chapters.title: Teasing
chapters.content:
Although the Shen family's estate was not small, they were ultimately merchants, and their residence could not exceed three bays and five purlins, so it wasn't particularly large.

From the front gate of the Shen family to the main hall was only a distance of a few hundred meters.

Yet Xie Xuchuan felt as though he had walked for a very long time.

Ever since he successively received the news of Cui Yulin's death and Jiang Huansu's pregnancy, he had not been able to rest properly. Yesterday, he had not slept at all the entire night.

Closing his eyes, his mind was a chaotic mess.

For a moment it was Cui Yulin, drenched all over, pitifully crying out that he was cold; the next moment it was Jiang Huansu holding her lower abdomen and sobbing softly; and turning his eyes again, it was Yuanzhu lowering her gaze to ask him, if he refused, to what extent would he go for Jiang Huansu.

Xie Xuchuan pressed his brow, his expression dazed.

Before dawn today, he had received a message from Zitao.

Jiang Huansu had Zitao inform him that she was going back to the Jiang family today to confess her crimes.

She also said that if she died, she entrusted him to collect her corpse and scatter the ashes of mother and child into the sea so that their family could be reunited.

Because of him, Cui Yulin had suffered a tragic death; how could Xie Xuchuan bear to let the bloodline of Jiang Huansu and Yulin meet the same fate?

Disregarding his body which had not rested for long, Xie Xuchuan hurried to the estate where Jiang Huansu was recuperating.

Not long after leaving the Xie family gate, he bumped into Jiang Huansu on the road.

His temples throbbed dully, and Xie Xuchuan pressed hard against them.

He was still somewhat dazed, his eyes filled entirely with images of Jiang Huansu weeping.

He saw himself holding onto Jiang Huansu, refusing to let her return to the Jiang family, while Jiang Huansu was stubbornly determined to go back and confess her crimes.

"My belly isn't showing much yet. Even if I return to the Jiang family and am not tolerated by my father, even if I'm put to death by him, outsiders won't be able to tell anything, and I can still preserve a clean reputation through death.

"But if it drags on any longer, when my belly grows large, a miscarriage will surely be forced upon me.

"Yulin has already met an end without an intact corpse; I do not want his last bloodline to face the same plight.

"Xuchuan, let me go back, let me take our child to find Yulin."

Jiang Huansu cried with sobs. "Do you know that the netherworld is now the only home for our family? Won't you let our family be reunited?"

With that, Jiang Huansu shook off Xie Xuchuan's hand.

"Huansu, listen to me, I won't let you come to that end."

Xie Xuchuan's eyes were crimson. "I promised Yulin I would protect you and the child in your womb, safe and sound until he returns.

"Trust me in this matter; I will surely give you an explanation."

The young man's voice choked, tears pooling in his eyes, stubbornly refusing to let them fall.

Xie Xuchuan lowered his head, gripping Jiang Huansu's wrist with a death grip. "Huansu, let's not make a scene on the street. Go back to the estate; I will go to the Shen family today."

Jiang Huansu didn't speak, only weeping softly, until Zitao half-dragged and pulled her back to the carriage.

Inside the carriage, Jiang Huansu lifted the carriage curtain, silently shedding tears, her eyes filled with utter despair.

She was now frighteningly thin, her sunken cheeks and bruised, swollen red eyes enough to startle Xie Xuchuan.

Xie Xuchuan stood on the street, weeping and begging, "You go back to the estate first. I'm going to the Shen family right now; today, I will definitely give you an explanation."

With that, he turned and walked toward the Shen family.

Xie Xuchuan's mind was left in utter chaos; he wasn't even clear on how he had arrived at the Shen family.

Right now, he was sitting in the main hall of the Shen family, with a cup of hot tea served by a Shen family maid placed beside his hand.

The lingering warmth burned his hand, and Xie Xuchuan finally seemed to recover a fraction of his sanity.

Conversations accompanied by smiles and laughter drifted in from outside the door, and Shen Yuanzhu's docile and gentle voice entered his ears, refreshing his lungs like a clear stream.

Xie Xuchuan was startled, and only then did he wake up a little more.

"Xuchuan, what an honor for your great arrival. Are you here to discuss marriage matters with our Yuanzhu? Let's make it clear first, our Yuanzhu isn't someone so easy to marry!"

Ye Yunyi swung her handkerchief as she stepped into the hall, smiling and teasing the two.

chapters.title: Dilemma
chapters.content:
Shen Yuanzhu was wearing a rattan-yellow *bijiashan* today, embroidered with auspicious patterns in silver thread that were terribly eye-catching.

Xie Xuchuan raised his eyes and saw Shen Yuanzhu’s long lashes drooping slightly as she avoided his gaze.

He hurriedly took a step forward, only realizing what he was doing once he reached Ye Yunyi's side.

If he truly spoke to Ye Yunyi now, Yuanzhu would likely hate him for the rest of her life.

How could he have been so muddled today about something he understood just yesterday?

Xie Xuchuan shook his dizzy head and took three steps back.

Standing straight, he smoothed his sleeves and raised his hands in a salute: "When I called upon the family yesterday, I failed to pay my respects to Sister-in-law. I’ve come early this morning to make amends, and I hope Sister-in-law will not take offense."

"No offense taken, none at all."

Ye Yunyi glanced at him and, seeing Xie Xuchuan’s exhausted appearance, figured he must have suffered the fatigue of the long journey back without proper rest.

Her resentment toward him for failing to greet her the previous day dissipated a good deal.

"Why stand on such ceremony? We’re practically family now; how could your sister-in-law possibly blame you?"

After a few conventional pleasantries, Shen Yuanzhu still had not spoken.

Seeing Xie Xuchuan repeatedly casting glances at Shen Yuanzhu, Ye Yunyi said, "I won't stay here making a nuisance of myself. The two of you probably still have things to say to one another."

With a teasing smile, Ye Yunyi told the two of them to go into the courtyard for a private chat.

Xie Xuchuan followed silently behind Shen Yuanzhu as she leisurely tossed pastry crumbs into the pond.

After a long silence, Xie Xuchuan asked, "Yuanzhu, what are your thoughts on what I spoke to you about yesterday?"

Shen Yuanzhu’s hand paused; then she tossed the remaining pastries entirely into the pond.

She turned around, her clear eyes fixed on Xie Xuchuan.

Unable to bear the scrutiny of her gaze, Xie Xuchuan awkwardly looked away.

"I thought I made myself quite clear yesterday."

Shen Yuanzhu said, "How you choose to settle Jiang Huanxiu is your affair, and I don't care if you wish to bring that child back to the Xie household. But making him the legitimate heir? Absolutely out of the question."

"Yuanzhu..."

Xie Xuchuan’s eyes reddened. "I have my reasons. Won't you please just agree?"

"What reasons?"

"I cannot say just yet."

Looking at the fish swimming leisurely in the pond, Xie Xuchuan’s mouth tasted of bitterness. "I committed a wrong and must make amends to Huanxiu. If I cannot make it up to her, my heart will find no peace for the rest of my life."

Shen Yuanzhu tilted her head, utterly uncomprehending. "What terrible wrong did you commit that requires making another person's child your legitimate heir to make amends?

"Even if you did wrong Jiang Huanxiu, it gives you no right to drag the Shen family into this.

"You keep claiming that child will not touch the Shen family's assets, but all of the Xie family's dyeing business is built upon the foundation of the Shen family's dye manuals. You..."

"Yuanzhu!"

Before Shen Yuanzhu could finish, Xie Xuchuan hurriedly cut her off.

His eyes red, his grip on the veranda railing turned his knuckles stark white.

A stinging sensation rose in his nose, and a great wave of grievance welled up within him.

"All you ever talk about is the Xie family's business, the Xie family's business! Did you marry me just for the Xie family's business?

"From yesterday until today, you haven't asked me a single time what actually happened between Jiang Huanxiu and me!

"Do you have me in your heart at all?"

Seeing Shen Yuanzhu lower her gaze and stay silent, Xie Xuchuan slammed his hand against the veranda pillar with a loud *crack*.

"Shen Yuanzhu, is it because you won't get the Xie family's business that you refuse to marry me?!"

The veins stood out on Xie Xuchuan's temples as he shouted, yet his eyes were filled with heartbreak.

He had hoped Shen Yuanzhu would stand unconditionally by his side, no matter his circumstances.

He knew Shen Yuanzhu was innocent, but Xie Xuchuan could not understand why emotions he could easily keep in check before outsiders all erupted at once before the person closest to him.

***

chapters.title: Agreement
chapters.content:
Shen Yuanzhu had only just come of age, and Xie Xuchuan was merely three years older than her.

A young man of unrestrained spirit naturally had a temper of his own.

Moreover, Xie Xuchuan had grown up cherished and doted upon by the entire Xie family; his inner pride was no less than anyone else's.

He had never suffered a setback in his life, only to be suddenly struck by the death of his close friend and the coercion of that friend’s widow.

Unable to bear the heavy burden in his heart, he had poured out all his pent-up grievances entirely upon Shen Yuanzhu.

Yet Shen Yuanzhu, though seemingly docile and gentle, possessed a core of unyielding steadfastness.

Had Xie Xuchuan lowered his head in a gentle, repentant tone, she would have spared him embarrassment for the sake of their youthful bond.

But now...

Shen Yuanzhu lifted her chin, a sharp, fierce light flashing in her eyes.

She extended a single finger and pressed it hard against Xie Xuchuan's chest: "Fine, then tell me: what actually happened between you and Jiang Huanxiu?"

"I..."

She stepped closer, forcing him back.

"You ask me if marrying you was just for the Xie family's business? Then let me ask you this: if, after we marry, I burn the remaining portions of the Shen family's dye manuals to ash, and the Xie family completely ceases using the dye formulas they currently employ, would your Xie family agree to that?"

Panicked, Xie Xuchuan stammered, "Yuanzhu, I didn't... I..."

"Xie Xuchuan, after today, I will never again inquire about your affairs with Jiang Huanxiu. Once we are married, the Xie family will not receive a single dye formula from the Shen family either.

"Go have Madam Xie come and speak to me. If the Xie family agrees to this, then I will agree to let you bring that child back into the Xie household, regardless of what status you intend to give him."

Standing before Xie Xuchuan, Shen Yuanzhu’s eyes flashed with vexation. "You, go back to the Xie household right now. If Old Madam Xie and Madam Xie agree, I will pretend none of this ever happened and our engagement remains as it is!"

"Yuanzhu."

Seeing that Shen Yuanzhu was genuinely angered, Xie Xuchuan panicked. "I'm sorry. I was just too tired; I didn't mean to blame you."

"I know you weren't blaming me, what standing do you even have to blame me? After all, the one who broke the covenant is you, and the one who secretly conceived a child with another is also you."

"I did no such thing!" Xie Xuchuan said sharply. "Yuanzhu, you ought to trust me. I would never betray you."

Shen Yuanzhu shook her head. "Whether I trust you or not is irrelevant; whether you betrayed me or not is also irrelevant. I ask you only this: as of today, are you still firmly set on making the child in Jiang Huanxiu's womb the legitimate heir of the Xie family?"

"I..."

Xie Xuchuan stammered and took two steps back.

"Enough, go back. My words stand: if the Xie family agrees not to use the Shen family's dye manuals, I will agree to your making anyone you please a legitimate heir. As for the rest, do as you please."

With that, Shen Yuanzhu turned to leave, but Xie Xuchuan intercepted her.

"Yuanzhu, by doing this, you are destroying the marriage alliance between the Xie and Shen families."

"..."

Stung to the point of a sharp ache in her eyes by Xie Xuchuan's words, Shen Yuanzhu looked into his brows and eyes, and in a fit of resentment, tore the jade pendant with its safety knot right off his waist.

She casually tossed the trinket into the pond and strode away.

Watching the ripples in the pond, Xie Xuchuan felt anger and bitterness slowly breeding deep within his heart.

He could not understand why the person who should have supported him most was willing to threaten the marriage alliance rather than hear another word from him.

As the safety pendant sank to the bottom of the pond, Xie Xuchuan pressed his lips into a thin line and, in a fit of fury, flicked his sleeves and left.

The moment Xie Xuchuan stepped out of the Shen residence, Zitang eagerly hurried over: "Young Master Xie, did Miss Shen agree?"

Having been relentlessly cornered by Jiang Huanxiu and now encountering Zitang, Xie Xuchuan felt a faint surge of annoyance.

Yet, thinking of Jiang Huanxiu's frail, sickly appearance, he slowly suppressed those complex emotions once more.

In a hoarse voice, Xie Xuchuan said, "She agreed. I am returning to the Xie family to discuss the matter with my mother..."

***

chapters.title: Lively
chapters.content:
Dismissing Zitang, Xie Xuchuan returned to the Xie residence in a daze.

The Xie family possessed vast wealth, and the servants they kept numbered in the countless.

Before he even stepped through the doors, an old woman from Old Madam Xie's quarters was already keeping watch at the entrance.

The moment she spotted Xie Xuchuan, she immediately began to fuss loudly, "The eldest young master is back! The old mistress has been waiting anxiously."

Xie Xuchuan paused in his tracks, only to hear the old woman continue: "The eldest young master has been back from Huizhou, yet absent from the estate for two full days. The old mistress has been searching high and low for you; she's simply longing to catch a glimpse of you."

"I will go pay my respects to Grandmother."

The old woman said, "The third master just returned and caught a few minnows. The old mistress has given word for the whole family to come and partake at noon."

Minnow flesh was tender, exceptionally delicious when steamed, and melted right in the mouth.

Though nothing exceptionally precious, since it was caught by the third young master of the Xie family himself, it was naturally out of the ordinary.

As the saying goes, the youngest child and the eldest grandson are the old mistress's very lifeblood.

Xie Jingyuan and Xie Xuchuan were the apple of Third Mistress Xie's eye and the treasures in her palm.

A single day apart, and she would miss and fret over them immensely.

Stepping into Yujin Hall, Xie Xuchuan found the room uncommonly lively.

His grandmother, Xie Sanniang, sat in the seat of honor, flanked by his parents, Xie Boyu and Hua Nanzhi.

Seated opposite his grandmother were his second uncle, Xie Chengzhi, and second aunt, Zheng Shu.

In Zheng Shu's arms sat five-year-old Xie Yingshou, who was currently clutching a handful of hair belonging to his older sister, Xie Lurong, and refusing to let go.

Though Xie Lurong was already of age, she had been raised timid and cowardly by the second branch's couple; even when her scalp hurt from being pulled, she dared not cry out, only hunching her shoulders with a red-eyed whimpering sound.

Seeing this, Xie Xuchuan slightly frowned and pried Xie Yingshou's fingers apart.

"Thank you, Eldest Brother."

Xie Lurong mumbled softly, carefully retreating to the side.

Upon seeing Xie Xuchuan step through the door, Old Madam Xie hurriedly stood up: "Come, let Grandmother take a look at you."

Xie Sanniang extended a pair of wrinkled yet delicately maintained hands to gently stroke Xie Xuchuan's cheek: "Good child, where have you been these past two days? Look at you, just look at the dark circles under your eyes. You must have suffered terribly all the way in Huizhou, haven't you?"

"Grandmother."

Bathed in Xie Sanniang's tender concern, Xie Xuchuan choked up for a fraction of a second.

In this world, only his grandmother and his mother truly cherished him.

Xie Xuchuan gently grasped Xie Sanniang's hand, listening to her aged yet spirited voice: "Someone, go brew some nourishing soup for the eldest young master! My Chuan'er endured such hardship along the way, he's actually grown this thin..."

"Oh, Mother, you mustn't be quite so partial."

Xie Chengzhi, the second master of the Xie family, crossed his arms and smiled half-heartedly. "When Xuchuan went to Huizhou, aside from the silver for purchasing goods, he took a full extra thousand taels. Why, even if he sold every piece of merchandise in Huizhou, he might not have turned a profit matching a single trip's expenses."

Xie Xuchuan's second aunt, Zheng Shu, chimed in with a smile, "Indeed, a full thousand taels of silver! That would be more than enough even for a sightseeing tour along the way. How could he possibly be worn to such a state of exhaustion?"

Her gaze swept back and forth across Xie Xuchuan's face before she bounced Xie Yingshou in her arms. "Yingshou, when you grow up, make sure you thoroughly please the old mistress. With the old mistress protecting you, any path you take in the future will be a broad and smooth highway."

"What is sister-in-law implying..."

Hua Nanzhi smiled gently. "With Mother holding up the Xie family, which of our children isn't walking a broad and smooth highway?

"It was Xuchuan's first time going to Huizhou; naturally, he had to cultivate good relations with the local merchants there.

"Besides, if I recall correctly, when Second Uncle made his first business trip, he ruined an entire cart of Yunqi silk? That single cart of silk must have been worth countless thousands of taels, yet I don't recall anyone dwelling on it quite like this."

"Big Sister-in-law is speaking nonsense. That ruined silk was through no fault of our second master."

"Oh, is that so? Where that ruined silk went remains a mystery, not a single thread was left behind, though the second master did manage to linger in the pleasure houses for half a year after his return..."

"Enough."

Xie Boyu broke in to cut Hua Nanzhi off. "What's the use of bringing up the past? And you, Xuchuan, the public funds are not for you to squander on pleasure. When you return, hand over the accounts for this entire journey to me. Whatever is left over goes back into the public treasury, and whatever you overspent, you will make up out of your own pocket."

Xie Xuchuan lowered his head. "Understood, Father."

Hua Nanzhi clutched her handkerchief, lowering her gaze to conceal the hatred in her eyes.

This husband of hers had never once been of one heart with her!

Zheng Shu smiled contemptuously.

She had thought a few sharp words would put the matter to rest, but unexpectedly, Xie Chengzhi slammed up to his feet with a *bang*.

"Big Sister-in-law, what do you mean by that? Are you accusing me of swallowing a cart of silk? Make yourself clear! If this gets out, how will outsiders view me, the Second Master of the Xie family?"

"Did you not?"

Hua Nanzhi stood up as well. "Not even going back far, just the other day when you audited the storehouse..."

"I said enough!"

Xie Boyu abruptly pulled Hua Nanzhi aside. "As a sister-in-law, why are you dragging your husband's younger brother into this over nothing? Apologize to Chengzhi."

Hearing this, Hua Nanzhi looked at Xie Boyu in disbelief, and Xie Xuchuan also furrowed his brows.

Zheng Shu gave the young Xie Yingshou in her arms a pinch, making a theatrical move as if to burst into wailing tears.

For a moment, the room dissolved into complete chaos.

At that moment, Xie Jingyuan lifted the pearl curtain threaded with southern red agate beads and chuckled softly, "My, how lively."

***

chapters.title: Xie Qi
chapters.content:
"Jingyuan is here?"

Upon seeing Xie Jingyuan, Xie Sanniang beamed, the wrinkles on her face softening by a good third.

"Mother."

Dressed in a moon-white unlined long gown, Xie Jingyuan strode into Yujin Hall.

Xie Sanniang took Xie Xuchuan by one hand and Xie Jingyuan by the other, the joy in her eyes overflowing.

Xie Boyu wore a faint smile, while the second branch's couple wore expressions of undisguised disdain.

Xie Chengzhi, burning with resentment, wanted to stir up a few more rows, but before he could speak, Xie Sanniang glared him back into silence.

"Shut that mouth of yours. If Huizhou was such a fine errand, why did you push it off onto Xuchuan?"

Xie Sanniang snorted coldly, "You are lazy and arrogant; you refuse whatever is handed to you, and only know how to eye what's in other people's bowls, disrupting the peace of the household day in and day out."

"Second Brother was only thinking of the family."

Xie Jingyuan patted his mother's hand. "We mustn't work ourselves into a temper before a meal, or we won't be able to enjoy the fresh fish I caught myself."

Xie Jingyuan had just reached the age of twenty; he stood tall at eight feet and possessed a natural, effortless grace.

Even in a plain, unlined scholarly gown, he cut a dashing, high-spirited, and free-and-easy figure.

Moreover, every movement he made carried a certain untamed, wandering charm characteristic of a martial hero, making him stand out dazzlingly in a crowd and impossible to ignore.

As soon as he spoke, he coaxed Xie Sanniang into radiant delight, causing her to laugh out loud: "How could that be? Fish caught by Jingyuan's own hands surpass any mountain delicacy or oceanic treasure."

Seeing the sullen expressions on the faces of the second branch's couple, Xie Jingyuan added, "A friend of mine sent me an imported mercury mirror. Since I'm not yet settled, I have no use for such delicate women's trinkets; later, I'll have someone send it over to Second Sister-in-law's quarters."

Imported goods were always considered precious, and Xie Chengzhi and Zheng Shu were both accustomed to greedily snapping up favors. Hearing this, their expressions smoothed out and smiles bloomed on their faces.

Xie Boyu helped Xie Sanniang back down to her seat, standing behind her to secretly cast an appreciative glance toward Xie Jingyuan.

Xie Jingyuan raised an eyebrow slightly, subtly indicating that Hua Nanzhi's expression was still poor.

Xie Boyu looked troubled; Xie Jingyuan couldn't help but blink at him.

This was a private code the two brothers had used since childhood. Xie Boyu understood that it meant he had also brought a gift for Hua Nanzhi, telling him to take it later to appease his own wife.

Xie Boyu smiled, clasping his fists in gratitude as he waggled them at his dear third younger brother.

Though the two brothers exchanged numerous small gestures, none of the others paid them any mind.

With Xie Jingyuan and Xie Xuchuan present, the smile never left the corners of Xie Sanniang's mouth.

With the matriarch of the Xie family in high spirits, the room naturally returned to an atmosphere of harmony.

The previous friction dissipated like dust in the wind, replaced entirely by family joy.

Laughter echoed continuously through the room, and even the usually timid and cowardly Xie Lurong bit her lip, smiling softly as she conversed with the maid beside her.

Until Xie Qi walked into the room.

The entire house fell into an instant silence.

Xie Sanniang's smile faded, and the second branch's couple exchanged a glance, their expressions peculiar.

Upon seeing Xie Qi, Hua Nanzhi lightly turned her face away, while Xie Boyu wore a rare, awkward expression.

"Grandson pays his respects to Grandmother."

Xie Qi walked up to Xie Sanniang and bowed in greeting.

Xie Sanniang asked, "Is the minnow dish ready? If it is, we shall dine."

With that, leading her attendant maid, she walked over to the rosewood table at the side.

Hua Nanzhi stood up to follow, and the Xie family's second branch trailed closely behind, leaving Xie Qi standing right where he was.

Though Xie Qi and Xie Xuchuan were twin brothers, they actually bore little physical resemblance to one another, nor did they share the indistinguishable stature typical of twins.

He was much taller than Xie Xuchuan, entirely devoid of the youthful lankiness that clung to his brother.

Xie Qi's brows bore a striking resemblance to Xie Jingyuan's, but unlike Xie Jingyuan's clear and gentle refinement, Xie Qi's eyelids were thin and sharp. His supremely handsome features naturally lent him a certain aggressive edge.

Furthermore, Xie Qi possessed a narrow waist, broad shoulders, and long, powerful legs. Though they were twins, it was as if he alone had matured with time, quietly leaving Xie Xuchuan far behind.

Seeing everyone ignore him and walk away, Xie Qi lowered his gaze, slowly masking all his subtle, complicated thoughts beneath an expression of profound, gloomy melancholy.

chapters.title: Fish Banquet
chapters.content:
"What are you thinking about?"

Xie Jingyuan walked up to Xie Qi and smiled. "I haven't seen you for a few days. Are you still cooped up in Jiucai Residence?"

"I've been reading in my room."

In the Xie family, only Xie Shan and Xie Jingyuan treated Xie Qi well.

In an ordinary household, a younger generation favored by the head of the family would undoubtedly be pampered like stars surrounding the moon, much like Xie Xuchuan.

Unfortunately, Xie Shan was only a domestic servant of the Xie family. In his early years, Lady Xie took him in as a matrilocal husband, so he only had the empty title of head of the family.

However, times changed. Although Xie Shan was a matrilocal husband, he possessed great business acumen and soon expanded the Xie family business.

Realizing that the Xie family business could not do without his assistance, Xie Shan grew confident and gradually grew dissatisfied with merely being a matrilocal husband.

With ambitions growing, resentment was inevitable.

Back then, the relationship between Xie Shan and Lady Xie was walking on thin ice. It was no exaggeration to say that they looked at each other with the intense hatred of mortal enemies.

Their marital affection was worn away bit by bit, nearly resulting in a lose-lose situation for both.

Later, perhaps realizing the drawbacks, the two slowly improved their relationship over many years of living together.

Yet, a crack had formed after all, and within the inner quarters of the Xie household, the husband and wife operated almost under the principle of avoiding each other.

Lady Xie could not stomach Xie Qi, so Xie Shan deliberately elevated Xie Qi out of spite. It was just a pity that Xie Shan's origins were humble, and compared to Lady Xie, he was ultimately half a notch lower and could not override Lady Xie's authority in the Xie household.

Xie Jingyuan only knew that his parents' relationship was not harmonious, but he could not understand why the two twin nephews, who were only three years younger than himself, were treated like heaven and earth.

In the Xie family, Xie Qi was like a rotting, foul-smelling melon fruit in some obscure corner during the summer.

Usually, no one cared whether he lived or died, but if anyone happened to run into him, they all... thoroughly detested him.

"You, your temperament is just too quiet."

Seeing Xie Qi standing alone, Xie Jingyuan walked shoulder-to-shoulder with him. "I acquired some imported goods the other day. Go to Zhiyun Pavilion later to pick through them carefully, and take whatever you like."

"Thank you, Third Uncle."

"Why so polite?"

Patting Xie Qi on the shoulder, Xie Jingyuan urged him to sit down quickly.

"Third Master's fish is truly excellent. This old servant just passed by the small kitchen and smelled that aroma..."

Nose twitching gently, Lady Xie's dowry maid, Mother Li, amusedly remarked, "Aigoo, it smells so fragrant it nearly makes one's tongue drop off from craving."

As she spoke, she directed the young maid beside her to place small white porcelain plates specially used for eating fish, as well as silver forks used for picking out fish bones, in front of everyone one by one.

The maid arranged a circle of plates, and when she reached Xie Qi, she realized one set was missing.

The young girl was somewhat stunned. Seeing that everyone at the table acted as if they hadn't noticed, she turned to step back, thinking of getting another set.

Xie Qi rarely appeared together with the Xie family, though the past few years had been slightly better.

In earlier years, even the Xie family members almost forgot that their Eldest Young Master and Second Young Master were twins.

Everyone acted as if they hadn't seen the missing set of bowls and dishes. Mother Li continued standing beside Xie Jingyuan to curry favor, "Old Madam's stomach has been uneasy these past few days. Drinking Third Master's fish soup today will probably cure her ailment at once."

"Mother is feeling unwell?"

"It's an old ailment..."

The fish Xie Jingyuan caught was truly wonderful. The small kitchen made a full fish banquet today, featuring pan-frying, stir-frying, braising, and deep-frying.

Xie Qi sat beside Xie Xuchuan, lowering his head without a word, long accustomed to being the only one missing his utensils among a crowd of people.

Lady Xie gave the word, and everyone picked up their chopsticks to eat.

Hua Nanzhi ladled a bowl of soup for Xie Xuchuan and picked out the most tender piece of steamed fish belly for him.

The fish belly was garnished with emerald-green scallion shreds, with bright red chopped pickled peppers scattered sparingly over the top. The savory, numbing, and salty fragrance of the fish, mixed with an oily, rich aroma, drifted straight into the nostrils, stirring one's appetite.

"Such fresh fish, hurry up and taste it."

Xie Xuchuan shook his head, having no appetite.

His mind was filled with vexing thoughts; how could he possibly have the appetite to eat?

Thinking of Jiang Huansu and Shen Yuanzhu, Xie Xuchuan pinched the bridge of his nose, "Mother, I have something to tell you after the meal."

Since Shen Yuanzhu said Mother agreed, she had consented to bring Huansu and Yulin's child back to the Xie family, so he would let the other party...

***

chapters.title: Inquiring
chapters.content:
Xie Xuchuan was utterly exhausted, and Hua Nanzhi felt heartbroken seeing him like this.

Turning sideways, she leaned close to Xie Xuchuan's ear and said, "Ever since you returned from Huizhou, I've noticed you looking so worried. Has something happened?"

Pausing for a moment, Xie Xuchuan nodded.

"Eat something first."

"I can't eat."

Hua Nanzhi showed a helpless expression. "You've been too lazy to pick fish bones since you were a child. I never thought you'd still be like this now that you're grown."

As she spoke, she lowered her head to meticulously pick the bones out of the fish meat, failing to notice the flash of intrigue that crossed Xie Qi's eyes upon hearing the word "happened."

The snow-white fish meat was flaked into fine shreds, and Hua Nanzhi used a silver fork to flip through it several more times before carefully placing the broken fish meat, soaked in soup and saturated with a salty, fresh flavor, into Xie Xuchuan's bowl.

"Eat more and build up your strength."

Mother Li finished currying favor with Xie Jingyuan and then walked back behind Lady Xie.

Xie Jingyuan picked up his chopsticks and turned his head, only to see the space in front of Xie Qi completely empty.

His brow furrowed slightly, and he casually placed his own untouched tableware in front of Xie Qi.

Just as he made this motion, he heard Lady Xie say to Mother Li, "What are you paid for? Why haven't you gone to get a set of dishes and bowls for the Third Master?"

"Coming, coming."

As soon as Lady Xie's anger flared, the young maid who had laid the bowls and dishes earlier walked in.

Mother Li saw this and let loose a torrent of scoldings right in her face.

The young maid aggrievedly said, "Second Young Master doesn't eat fish, so I didn't bring his plates and bowls."

Xie Boyu felt displeased upon hearing this.

Xie Qi didn't eat fish? How come he didn't know?

When did the Second Young Master of the Xie family become someone whose tableware a mere maid could arbitrarily arrange?

Just as he was about to reprimand her, he heard his own mother say, "Is he some precious treasure? If he doesn't eat, he doesn't eat. Do you all have to bicker and quarrel over such trivial matters while eating?

"It completely ruins the appetite for eating fish."

With a slap, Lady Xie put down her soup spoon.

The plates and bowls were placed before him. Xie Qi lowered his gaze to stare at them, a sneering smile pulling at the corner of his lips.

Xie Jingyuan wanted to say something to smooth things over, but saw that Xie Qi had already stood up, bowed to the crowd, and turned to leave.

"Xie Qi."

"Let him go."

Lady Xie said, "Just looking at him ruins the appetite. Let's eat."

Xie Xuchuan looked at Xie Qi's back and lowered his voice, "Mother... Younger brother, he..."

"Eat your food, pay no mind to the rest."

The hand serving Xie Xuchuan food paused. Hua Nanzhi's brow furrowed tightly before she slowly relaxed it.

The curses from behind drifted on the wind to his ears. Xie Qi walked toward Jiucai Residence with a gloomy expression on his face.

When he was just a little boy, the Xie family had assigned him to Jiucai Residence.

Jiucai Residence was located at the westernmost part of the Xie family estate, near the far end of the pond.

It was damp and cold in the winter, and scorched by the western sun in the summer. It was extremely uncomfortable, a far cry from Xie Xuchuan's Tiqi Courtyard.

Now that it was April, the entire Jiucai Residence was still bone-chillingly cold and damp.

Xie Qi walked into his room and casually pinched a white jade button to play with at his fingertips.

At the moment, he was half-reclining in a nanmu armchair, the bold and unrestrained demeanor completely replacing his earlier restraint.

When Mianhe rubbed her hands and entered the room, she happened to catch this sight.

A wave of heat surged in her heart, and her cheeks flushed with two red blooms.

"Second Young Master..."

"The room is damp and cold. Go find Mother Li and ask for some charcoal fire."

Her hand was just about to lift the beaded curtain when Mianhe was abruptly dismissed.

A flash of displeasure crossed her face, but she quickly suppressed it.

"If Master continues to pay no heed, you're going to inflate this girl's ambitions."

As Mianhe left, a young boy walked into Xie Qi's room.

The boy had a tiger-head, cat-brain look with thick eyebrows and big eyes, appearing extremely clever.

Xie Qi gave a disdainful cold snort; a maid was not yet worth him taking seriously.

Thinking of the scene where Hua Nanzhi picked fish bones for Xie Xuchuan earlier, Xie Qi abruptly withdrew the jade button from his fingertips.

A hint of gloom dyed his eyes, but his tone remained very frivolous: "My good brother caused trouble in Huizhou. Go to the Eldest Branch and investigate what happened."

***

chapters.title: Not Necessarily
chapters.content:
"No wonder I noticed Xie Xuchuan's complexion looked so terrible."

Wei Hu patted his chest and gave a chuckle. "Young Master, rest assured. Leave this matter to me, and I'll definitely handle it for you impeccably."

With that, Wei Hu flipped over the window and jumped out.

Xie Xuchuan was still eating the full fish banquet at Yujin Hall, while Wei Hu turned and headed to the Xie family's storage room.

When Mianhe swayed her waist and arrived at the storage room, Wei Hu was already squatting in the corner on guard.

He had always detested Mianhe, so he loved catching her little infractions in secret to report to Xie Qi.

Right now, Wei Hu crouched by the base of the wall, holding a broom and spinning it around.

"Manager Sun."

Leaning against the storage room entrance, Mianhe called out sweetly.

"Lady Mianhe."

Upon seeing Mianhe, Sun Qi broke into a full face of smiles. "Just yesterday I was muttering about how I hadn't seen you come by in a long time, and today here you are. Would you say the two of us have some affinity?"

"Pfft, who has an affinity with you?"

Mianhe spat lightly, though the smile on her face did not fade. "Second Young Master instructed me to come get some charcoal..."

Hearing Xie Qi's name, Sun Qi's face assumed a lukewarm expression.

"What charcoal do you need in April? Summer is practically around the corner. Young Miss Luxuan and Young Master Yingshou in the Second Branch have both been cut off from charcoal, yet Second Young Master, a grown man, is more precious than young ladies and children?"

Mianhe shot Sun Qi a sideways glance, her uptight corners of her eyes carrying a hint of flirtatiousness. "Charcoal belongs to the public estate, it's not being dug out of your pocket. Why are you guarding it so tightly?"

Her figure was well-proportioned, slender yet full, and her waist and hips could sway into graceful curves as she walked. Sun Qi had been drooling over her for a long time.

Now, seeing this coquettish and alluring look, he felt an intense itch in his heart.

Rolling his eyes, Sun Qi said, "Although things belong to the public estate, they are under my jurisdiction, aren't they? Other courtyards are one thing, but Jiucai Residence..."

He curled his lip in disdain. "Even if you asked the Mistress or the Old Madam, you definitely wouldn't get any."

Who didn't know that the Second Young Master was jinxed and out of favor with the Old Madam and the Mistress?

"Hey, you fellow..."

"Don't be upset, lass."

Sun Qi reached out and grabbed Mianhe's hand, rubbing it gently. "Second Young Master might not be able to get charcoal, but that doesn't mean you can't.

"For your sake, I'll have the charcoal loaded up for you in a moment."

Pulling her into the Xie family's storage room, Sun Qi leaned in close. "Speaking of which, Mianhe, instead of following Second Young Master, you'd be better off following me.

"In the Xie family, Xie Qi will never make something of himself. He's not even as well off as a manager like me.

"Look, following him, even if you want a basket of charcoal, you have to beg others. Following me is different, my mother is Old Madam's trusted confidante. If you follow me, you can at least rise to become a managing senior maid."

A maid following a young master had no official status in the Xie family. If it were other young masters, that would be one thing, as one could at least reap some benefits.

Following Xie Qi...

Not starving to death in Jiucai Residence would already be an extremely good outcome.

Mianhe looked down at her increasingly rough hands and didn't pull away from Sun Qi's grip for a moment.

It wasn't until she heard a thud outside, the sound of something breaking, that she suddenly snapped back to her senses.

"I've been serving in Jiucai Residence for so many years. Wouldn't it be a pity to give up now?"

Pulling back her hand, Mianhe carelessly smoothed her hair. "And you're wrong. I, you know, might not necessarily lack a chance to get ahead."

Tapping Sun Qi's cheek frivolously, Mianhe's eyes and brows were full of charm. "It's impossible for the Old Madam and the Mistress to arrange a good marriage for Second Young Master.

"Once Eldest Young Master marries the Shen family's young miss, I'll go beg Old Madam for a favor. It might not be impossible for me to become the Second Young Master's wife of the Xie family.

"After all, there's a difference between being a master's wife and a servant who waits on others."

At the very worst, Xie Qi was still a legitimate master of the Xie family.

Not to mention, Xie Qi possessed a handsome face that made her whole body burn just looking at it.

***

chapters.title: Dream On
chapters.content:
"Good, haha, what a fine 'young master's wife'."

Sun Qi laughed until his waist bent, but it wasn't a mocking laugh.

He pulled Mianhe into his arms and gave her a thorough fondling. "Marrying the young master is good. Making romance with a maid can't compare to making romance with a young master's wife; that feeling must be intoxicating."

"Bah!"

Mianhe spat at him. "Shameless, who wants to make romance with you?"

With that, she chuckled and pushed Sun Qi away.

Having taken advantage of her, Sun Qi happily went to pack the charcoal, while Mianhe bantered with him back and forth.

The two chatted warmly, infuriating Wei Hu, who was squatting by the wall, to the point of pounding his chest and stamping his feet.

His master was actually being entangled by a toad!

Wei Hu gave a cold snort and decided to report back to his master after finishing his trip to the Eldest Branch.

Because the heads of the Xie household were at odds with each other, the servants also fought fiercely.

Xie Shan's confidants couldn't control Lady Xie's people, and likewise, Lady Xie's people had nowhere to vent their strength against those loyal to Xie Shan.

This led the Xie family's servants to form cliques, mostly lawless and disobedient.

Precisely because of this, Wei Hu could wander around anywhere all day long to gather information.

He swaggered into Xuanji Courtyard holding a broom and found a place to hide.

When Xie Xuchuan and Hua Nanzhi returned, Wei Hu lazily stretched and perked up his ears with little interest.

Merchant households only had trivial, petty matters; Wei Hu's enthusiasm wasn't high.

Just as he was pondering over Mianhe, he suddenly saw Xie Xuchuan drop to his knees before Hua Nanzhi.

Wei Hu's heart tightened, and he suddenly recalled Xie Qi's meaningful expression when he said his good brother had caused trouble in Huizhou.

Rolling down from the tree, Wei Hu flashed over and pressed himself against the base of the window.

"What are you doing?"

Seeing Xie Xuchuan kneel down the moment he entered the room, Hua Nanzhi couldn't help but twitch her eyelids.

"Mother, this son has a matter he wishes to ask for your help with."

Perhaps having lost all face in front of Shen Yuanzhu, or perhaps because Xie Xuchuan was simply too exhausted from running around over this matter, he unexpectedly showed a rare trace of calmness at the moment.

"Huansu is pregnant, two months along. I want to bring the child in her womb back to the Xie family and adopt it under my and Yuanzhu's names."

"Wh, what?"

Hua Nanzhi showed a bewildered expression, as if she hadn't understood for a moment.

Outside the window, Wei Hu's jaw dropped wide open.

"Huansu is pregnant..."

"Huansu? Jiang Huansu?"

Hua Nanzhi's voice was piercingly shrill. "Don't you usually like Yuanzhu? How did you get mixed up with Jiang Huansu again? How on earth does the Jiang family teach their daughters?"

Xie Xuchuan felt bitter inside, yet he offered no refutation.

"I do not agree."

Hua Nanzhi's brow furrowed tightly. "When the Old Madam took in a matrilocal husband back then, she specifically established a rule prohibiting concubines, so not a single concubine has ever appeared in the Xie family."

"Mother, I have no intention of taking a concubine."

"You have no intention?"

Hua Nanzhi stood up. "You may have no intention, but Jiang Huansu might not. I'm afraid you were schemed against by her."

"You've misunderstood Huansu."

"I misunderstood?"

Hua Nanzhi sneered. "What kind of person is Jiang Hong? He is an old schemer who calculates every angle, curries favor up and down, and has no bottom line at all.

"What kind of good thing could his daughter be? If she knew any propriety, would she have entangled herself with you knowing full well you were betrothed to Yuanzhu?"

"You've truly lost your mind. Her child is only two months along, and you talk about bringing it back to the Xie family. Are you bringing it back the moment it's born, or after she has nursed and raised it for a while?

"I know your temperament; you wouldn't come up with such an outrageous, terrible idea. Was it that little hussy who taught you to say this?

"She wants to step into my Xie family's door relying on a belly?

"Dream on!"

chapters.title: Slap
chapters.content:
"Mother, it's not like that."

Xie Xuchuan said, "It has nothing to do with Wansu, nor did she pester me..."

"Could it be that you pestered her, then?"

"Yes."

Xie Xuchuan lowered his head to the ground.

His hands clawed tightly into the blue bricks on the floor, his voice carrying a plea: "Mother, I have wronged Wansu. All of this was my idea; I owe her, and I must repay it.

"Mother, please help me. Your son truly has no other way out."

His voice was filled with exhaustion, and the barely suppressed choking sound made Hua Nanzhi's heart ache.

"Tell your mother, what on earth is going on?"

Cui Yulin's death was like a heavy stone pressing upon his chest, and whenever he thought of it, it filled Xie Xuchuan with agonizing pain.

Throughout his life, his father had been strict and his mother loving.

His betrothed, chosen since childhood, was gentle, beautiful, and came from a wealthy family.

His grandparents also cherished him, and the greatest setback he had ever encountered was perhaps not being close enough to his twin brother.

Life had been far too smooth, leaving Xie Xuchuan utterly incapable of coping when faced with such a crisis.

He spent entire nights unable to sleep, harboring both fear and remorse in his heart.

Having returned from Huizhou many days ago, he did not dare to go see Yulin's father, let alone inform him that Cui Yulin had perished.

Xie Xuchuan thought that only after Wansu and the child in her womb were both settled would he have the face to go before him and beg for punishment.

Yet Xie Xuchuan had never imagined that all of this would prove so difficult.

He knew that neither his grandmother nor his mother would ever tolerate the bloodline of the Xie family being tainted.

After a long silence, Xie Xuchuan pressed his forehead against the floor and muttered vaguely, "It was me... it was after drinking... I owe her. Mother, I beg you to grant your son this."

"You!"

Hua Nanzhi snatched the teapot from the table and smashed it fiercely onto the floor. "How can you face Yuanzhu? Yuanzhu has treated you with such deep affection, and this is how you repay her?"

"Your son didn't want this either. Your son truly didn't want this."

The grievance of having no one understand him made Xie Xuchuan inexplicably agitated, and he blurted out recklessly, "Yuanzhu agreed to it. Yuanzhu agreed to welcome Wansu's child into the Xie family.

"As long as..."

"As long as what?"

"As long as the Xie family stops using the Shen family's dyeing recipes."

"You..."

Hua Nanzhi was so enraged by Xie Xuchuan that she reeled backward. "Is that agreeing? That is merely refusing with an impossibility."

"Mother! Yuanzhu has relented after all. As long as you agree, this matter will produce no further complications."

"How could I possibly agree? Even if I did, your grandmother and the entire Xie family would never agree."

Clutching her chest, Hua Nanzhi said, "Xuchuan, have you lost your mind? It is true you are the eldest legitimate grandson of the Xie family, but do you truly think you outweigh the importance of the Shen family's dyeing recipes?

"Before you went to Huizhou, rumors were already circulating that Jiang You, the Superintendent of Imperial Manufactures, had offended nobles in the palace, and whether he can retain his position at the Bureau of Manufactures this year remains unknown.

"Without Jiang You, the Jiang family is worth less than dirt. You would trade Jiang Wansu for the Shen family's dyeing recipes?

"If word gets out, everyone in the Xie family will think you've gone stark raving mad."

Do not look at how harmonious the Xie family currently appears on the surface; if the Shen family's dyeing recipes were indeed lost through his hands, the second branch would immediately jump out to declare Xie Xuchuan incompetent and incapable of taking over the family enterprise.

Judging by Madame Xie San's doting affection for Xie Jingyuan, to whose head this family fortune might eventually fall is truly hard to say.

Seeing her son kneeling and prostrating himself weakly on the ground, Hua Nanzhi's heart softened as well. "Xuchuan, listen to your mother's advice. As for Wansu, Mother will help you resolve it. No matter what she wants, Mother can compensate her.

"If she insists on giving birth to the child, Mother can settle her outside, but it is utterly impossible to bring her back into the Xie family."

"Does Mother mean to make Wansu a kept mistress?"

Xie Xuchuan shook his head. "Mother, how can we humiliate Wansu like that?"

"What else? Bring her back, and if that causes Yuanzhu to be unwilling to hand over the Shen family's dyeing recipes, what then? Shall we let the Xie family's fortune flow into another branch's hands?"

"The fortune, the fortune! Why do all of you keep saying 'the Xie family's fortune' at every turn?"

Xie Xuchuan stood up, fixing a pair of bloodshot, angry eyes on Hua Nanzhi. "Is the fortune really that important? Are the Shen family's dyeing recipes really that important?"

"Of course they are important. How many years did it take the Xie family to build the reputation of Xie family cloud brocade? Now we are just one step away from becoming imperial merchants.

"With the Shen family's dyeing recipes, the Xie family can dye rare primary colors such as deep purple and madder red. Do you have any idea what this means for the Xie family?

"Chuan'er, listen to your mother. Leave this matter to Mother to resolve; Mother will certainly not let it affect the affection between you and Yuanzhu."

The constant refrain of the family fortune, the constant refrain of the dyeing recipes, all of it filled Xie Xuchuan with hatred.

He began to doubt whether true affection genuinely existed between him and Shen Yuanzhu.

Did his grandmother and mother treat him so well solely because he was betrothed to Shen Yuanzhu, could secure the recipes, and was of benefit to the Xie family?

For no apparent reason, Xie Xuchuan thought of Xie Qi.

"If I do not marry Yuanzhu, will you treat me just the way you treat Xie Qi? Xie Qi, an existence whose very name is superfluous, how can you be so cruel?"

The moment the words fell, Hua Nanzhi struck Xie Xuchuan across the face with a slap.

Xie Xuchuan covered his face, his expression stunned.

After a long pause, Hua Nanzhi said, "In short, this matter is impossible. Do not mention it again, and do not go before Yuanzhu..."

"Mother, I am determined to bring Wansu and the child in her womb through the gates of the Xie family."

"What mad words are you uttering?"

Xie Xuchuan's expression was exceedingly calm; it was impossible to tell whether that slap had beaten him into sobriety or driven him even madder.

Xie Xuchuan said, "Mother, help me go speak to Yuanzhu. Tell her the Xie family agrees to all her demands. As long as the betrothal remains unchanged, once Yuanzhu marries into the family, I have a way to make her produce the other dyeing recipes."

chapters.title: Betrothal
chapters.content:
"You intend to deceive Yuanzhu?"

Hua Nanzhi was deeply disappointed. "Yuanzhu has a gentle disposition, but Shen Yanhua is not someone to be trifled with. Do you take the entire Shen family to be soft dough like Yuanzhu?"

"I am not deceiving Yuanzhu."

He and Wansu were innocent; they were merely forced by circumstances right now. Once Yuanzhu married into the family, he would explain everything clearly.

"Mother, help me..."

Hua Nanzhi looked at the exhausted Xie Xuchuan and turned her face away in anger.

Until the room fell chillingly silent, she imitated Shen Yuanzhu's tone and said, "Have Shen Yanhua come to the Xie family to find your grandmother. If she agrees to this matter, I have no objections."

Hearing these words filled Xie Xuchuan's heart with despair.

"Are you going to force your son as well?"

"You are the one forcing me."

Inside the room, the voices of mother and son gradually grew sharp. Wei Hu covered his mouth, his eyes shining brightly.

He casually tossed the broom aside, hunched over, and scurried out of Xuanji Courtyard.

When he returned to Jiucai Residence, Xie Qi was sitting before the desk. The straight-hemmed robe he had worn earlier to Yujin Hall had been removed, leaving him in only a white inner garment.

That inner garment was as thin as a cicada's wing, faintly revealing the taut, powerful, and exquisite curves of his waist and abdomen.

He held a book in his hand, his long, sharply jointed fingers tapping gently against the spine, his expression tinged with a hint of impatience.

"Master."

Wei Hu ran in, his eyes glowing with vigor, so excited he slapped his thigh.

"Big news, big news!"

Xie Qi raised an eyebrow slightly, a look of disdain crossing his eyes.

"It really is big news!"

Wei Hu smacked his lips. "Xie Xuchuan and Jiang Wansu had a secret illicit affair, and she's even bun in the oven. Now he's making a huge fuss, crying and shouting about bringing her back into the Xie family."

Hearing this, Xie Qi let out a light snort. "A fool who has been pampered for too long."

"Master, with this happening, do you think Xie Xuchuan's betrothal to the Shen family can still hold? If he ruins his engagement with the Shens, won't he become a sinner of the Xie family?"

Tossing the book aside, Xie Qi smiled with contempt. "This brother of mine has always been simple-minded. I suppose having been coddled for so long, his brain has become like old cloth in the storehouse, completely infested with bookworms."

Xie Qi lowered his gaze, his fingertips slowly wandering along the spine of the book. "The engagement between the Xie and Shen families cannot be broken, but while the engagement cannot be broken, the person chosen for it might not necessarily remain the same."

"You mean to change the person?"

Wei Hu's eyes brightened. "Change to whom? Change to you, Master?"

His slender fingertips paused. Xie Qi lowered his eyelids, concealing the various thoughts that welled up in an instant.

"Master, if you were to marry the Shen family's young miss, bolstered by the Shen family's dyeing recipes, our business at Xiaxia Manor surpassing the Xie family would be just around the corner."

Over the years, following closely by Xie Qi's side and witnessing all kinds of behavior from the Xie family members firsthand, it was inevitable that he harbored hatred.

They were both legitimate grandsons of the Xie family's eldest branch, so why did Xie Xuchuan have everything while his master had to fight with others and scrap with dogs just to get a decent bite to eat?

For such a modest Xiaxia Manor, his master had no idea how much painstaking effort he had poured into establishing it.

"Master, that grandmother and mother of yours probably won't choose any good match for you."

Mentioning marriage, Wei Hu suddenly recalled Mianhe. "Right, I went to the storehouse with Mianhe just now and saw her acting all lovey-dovey with Sun Qi.

"And she even said that once Xie Xuchuan marries the Shen family's young miss, she'll go beg the old matriarch to make her your wife."

With eyes full of contempt, Wei Hu recounted the words of Sun Qi and Mianhe to Xie Qi, then sighed softly. "Master, the Xie family has trampled on you for so long; you must take your own marriage into your own hands. Relying on others will only bring you endless burdens."

Marry Shen Yuanzhu?

Listening to Wei Hu's words, Xie Qi furrowed his brow.
